title.zh: 卷五 本紀第五 太宗二
title.raw: 卷五 本紀第五 太宗二 Volume 5 Annals 5: Taizong 2

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙辰，以德恭為左武衛大將軍判濟州，封定安侯；

translations.literal: In year two, spring, first month, on bingchen, Degong was made Left Martial Guard Grand General with concurrent authority over Jizhou and enfeoffed as Marquis of Ding'an;
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo year two, on bingchen in the first month of spring, Degong was named left martial guard grand general and governor of Jizhou, with the title Marquis of Ding'an;

sentences.zh: 德隆為右武衛大將軍判沂州，封長寧侯。

translations.literal: Delong was made Right Martial Guard Grand General with concurrent authority over Yizhou and enfeoffed as Marquis of Changning.
translations.idiomatic: and Delong received the right martial guard, Yizhou, and the title Marquis of Changning.

sentences.zh: 右補闕劉蒙叟通判濟州，起居舍人韓儉通判沂州。

translations.literal: Right Remonstrance Clerk Liu Mengsou was made concurrent prefect of Jizhou; Attendant of the Bedchamber Han Jian concurrent prefect of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Mengsou, right remonstrance clerk, and Han Jian, attendant of the bedchamber, were sent as supervising prefects to Jizhou and Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜德恭、德隆常奉外支錢三百萬。

translations.literal: On yichou, Degong and Delong were granted three million cash beyond their regular stipends.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Yuan Zuo's sons Degong and Delong received three million cash on top of their regular allowances.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，權交州留後黎桓遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuyin, Acting Jiaozhou Military Commissioner Li Huan sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuyin, Li Huan, acting commissioner of Jiaozhou, dispatched tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙未，夏州李繼遷誘殺汝州團練使曹光實。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Li Jiqian of Xiazhou lured and killed Ruzhou military training commissioner Cao Guangshi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Li Jiqian of Xiazhou ambushed and killed Cao Guangshi, training commissioner of Ruzhou.

sentences.zh: 己亥，占城遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jihai, Champa sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Champa sent tribute bearers.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，親試禮部舉人。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiwei, he personally examined the Ministry of Rites examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on jiwei, he personally presided over the Ministry of Rites civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 江南民饑，許渡江自占。

translations.literal: The people of Jiangnan suffered famine; crossing the Yangtze to settle on their own was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck Jiangnan, and the court allowed refugees to cross the Yangtze and find land on their own.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥朔，遣使行江南諸州，振饑民及察官吏能否。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on yihai, the new-moon day, envoys were dispatched to travel the Jiangnan circuits to relieve the starving and assess whether officials were capable.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai new moon in the fourth month of summer he sent commissioners through Jiangnan to feed the hungry and grade local officials.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣忠武軍節度使潘美復屯三交口。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Loyal and Martial Army military commissioner Pan Mei was again stationed at Sanjiaokou.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he returned Pan Mei, commissioner of the Loyal and Martial Army, to garrison duty at Sanjiaokou.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔以帝所生官舍作啟聖院。

translations.literal: On jimao, an edict ordered that the official residence where the Emperor was born be made Qisheng Abbey.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he decreed that his birthplace be converted into Qisheng Abbey.

sentences.zh: 己丑，殿前承旨王著坐監資州兵為姦贓，棄市。

translations.literal: On jichou, Palace Front duty officer Wang Zhu, for corruption while supervising Zizhou troops, was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Wang Zhu, a palace front duty officer who had embezzled while commanding troops at Zizhou, was beheaded in public.

sentences.zh: 庚子，甘露降後苑。

translations.literal: On gengzi, sweet dew fell in the rear garden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi sweet dew fell in the imperial rear garden—a heaven-sent omen.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，夏州行營破西蕃息利族，斬其代州刺史折羅遇并弟埋乞，又破保、洗兩族，降五十餘族。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Xiazhou field army defeated the Xipo Xili tribe, beheading their acting prefect Zheluo Yu and his brother Maiqi, and also defeated the Bao and Xi tribes, accepting the surrender of more than fifty clans.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Xiazhou expedition crushed the Xili tribe of the Western Po, killing acting prefect Zheluo Yu and his brother Maiqi, then broke the Bao and Xi clans and took the surrender of fifty-odd groups.

sentences.zh: 五月甲子，幸城南觀麥，賜田夫布帛。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiazi, he visited the southern suburbs to view the wheat and bestowed cloth and silk on the farmers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiazi, he rode south to inspect the wheat crop and rewarded the field hands with cloth and silk.

sentences.zh: 天長軍蝝生。

translations.literal: Locusts hatched at Tianchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: A locust hatch broke out at Tianchang Army.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌朔，河西行營言，獲岌羅賦等十四族，焚千餘帳。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, the new-moon day, the Hexi field army reported capturing the Jiluofu and fourteen other tribes and burning more than a thousand tents.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon in the sixth month the Hexi command reported taking the Jiluofu confederation and thirteen allied tribes and burning over a thousand tents.

sentences.zh: 戊子，復禁鹽、榷酤。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the salt monopoly and liquor franchise were reimposed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he restored the state monopolies on salt and wine.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚申，詔諸道轉運使及長吏，宜乘豐儲廩以防水旱。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengshen, an edict ordered circuit transport commissioners and chief magistrates to store grain in good years against flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengshen, he told every circuit to fill granaries in bumper harvests before flood or drought could strike.

sentences.zh: 八月癸酉朔，遣使按問兩浙、荊湖、福建、江南東西路、淮南諸州刑獄，仍察官吏勤惰以聞。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guiyou, the new-moon day, envoys were dispatched to review criminal cases in the Two Zhes, Jinghu, Fujian, Jiangnan East and West circuits, and Huainan, and also to report on officials' diligence or sloth.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou new moon in the eighth month he sent investigators to audit prisons across the southeast and report which magistrates worked and which shirked.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，西南奉化王子以慈來貢。

translations.literal: On guisi, the prince of the Southwestern Pacification state Yici came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Prince Yici of the Southwestern Pacification state presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，瀛、莫二州大水。

translations.literal: That month, Ying and Mo prefectures suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: That month catastrophic floods hit Ying and Mo prefectures.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，以歲無兵凶，除十惡、官吏犯贓、謀故劫殺外，死罪減降，流以下釋之，及蠲江、浙諸州民逋租。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingwu, because the year had known no war or disaster, except for the ten abominations, official corruption, and plotted or bandit murder, death sentences were reduced or commuted, exile and lesser punishments were released, and arrears of rent in Jiang and Zhe circuits were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the ninth month, citing a year free of war and calamity, he commuted most capital crimes, freed everyone below exile, and canceled back rent across Jiangnan and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，重九，賜近臣飲于李昉第，召諸王、節度使宴射苑中。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the Double Ninth, he treated his close ministers to drink at Li Fang's residence and summoned the princes and military commissioners to feast and shoot in the imperial park.
translations.idiomatic: On the Double Ninth, gengxu, he hosted his inner circle at Li Fang's mansion and called the princes and frontier commissioners to an archery banquet in the palace park.

sentences.zh: 是夕，楚王宮火。

translations.literal: That night, fire broke out in the Prince of Chu's palace.
translations.idiomatic: That night flames consumed the Prince of Chu's palace.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，廢楚王元佐為庶人、均州安置。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Prince of Chu Yuan Zuo was demoted to commoner status and sent to live at Jun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Yuan Zuo, Prince of Chu, was stripped of rank, made a commoner, and exiled to Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，群臣請留元佐養疾京師，許之。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the hundred officials requested that Yuan Zuo be kept in the capital to nurse his illness; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court begged to keep the broken prince in the capital for medical care, and Taizong agreed.

sentences.zh: 己未，西南蕃王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jiwei, the king of the southwestern barbarians sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei a southwestern tribal king sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 己巳，禁海賈。

translations.literal: On jisi, overseas merchants were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he banned private maritime trade.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸未，太白入南斗。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on guwei, the Great White Star entered the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guwei, Venus entered the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 甲申，幸天駟監，賜從臣馬。

translations.literal: On jiashen, he visited the Imperial Horse Stud and bestowed horses on his attending ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he toured the imperial stud and gave horses to the officials in his train.

sentences.zh: 乙未，禁邕管殺人祭鬼及僧人置妻孥。

translations.literal: On yiwei, killing people to sacrifice to ghosts in Yong and Guan circuits was forbidden, as was monks keeping wives and children.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he outlawed human sacrifice in Yong and Guan and forbade Buddhist clergy from maintaining families.

sentences.zh: 己亥，均州獻一角獸。

translations.literal: On jihai, Jun prefecture presented a one-horned beast.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Junzhou sent up a unicorn as tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑朔，慮囚。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinchou, the new-moon day, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon in the tenth month of winter he held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以天竺僧天息災、施護、法天並為朝請大夫、試鴻臚少卿。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Indian monks Tianxizai, Shi Hu, and Fa Tian were all made Court Gentleman for Appearances and provisional Vice Director of the Court for State Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he named the Indian monks Tianxizai, Shi Hu, and Fa Tian court gentlemen and acting vice directors of the court for state ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 己酉，汴河主糧胥吏坐奪漕軍口糧，斷腕徇於河畔三日，斬之。

translations.literal: On jiyou, a Bian Canal grain clerk who had seized transport troops' rations had his wrists cut off and was displayed along the riverbank for three days, then beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou a Bian Canal pay clerk who had stolen soldiers' grain was mutilated at the wrist, paraded along the canal for three days, and then executed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，黎邛部蠻王子來貢。

translations.literal: On jiayin, a Li and Qiong tribal prince came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin a Li-Qiong tribal prince presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬午，狩於近郊，以所獲獻太廟，著為令。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renwu, he hunted near the capital; what he took was offered to the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and this was made regulation.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the eleventh month he hunted outside the walls and decreed that the kill be offered at the ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禱雪。

translations.literal: On wuzi, he prayed for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he ordered prayers for snow.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔在官丁父母憂者並放離任。

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict ordered that officials in mourning for father or mother all be released from duty.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he required every official mourning a parent to leave office at once.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengzi, the new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon in the twelfth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，南康軍言，雪降三尺，大江冰合，可勝重載。

translations.literal: On guimao, Nankang Army reported snow three feet deep, the great river frozen solid enough to bear heavy loads.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Nankang reported three feet of snow and a Yangtze freeze thick enough for loaded carts.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遣中使賜緣邊戍卒襦褲。

translations.literal: On dingwei, palace envoys were dispatched to bestow padded jackets and trousers on border garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he sent palace agents to issue winter clothing to frontier soldiers.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，門下侍郎兼刑部尚書、平章事宋琪罷守本官。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Vice Director of the Secretariat concurrent Minister of Justice and Associate Chief Councilor Song Qi was dismissed and kept his original office only.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Song Qi lost his seat as associate chief councilor but remained vice director and minister of justice.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，以檢校太師、忠武軍節度使潘美為雲、應、朔等州都部署，雲州觀察使楊業副之，出鴈門。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi, Acting Grand Master and Loyal and Martial Army military commissioner Pan Mei was made overall commander of Yun, Ying, Shuo, and other prefectures, with Yunzhou observation commissioner Yang Ye as his deputy; they marched out through Yanmen Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the second month he named Pan Mei supreme commander of the northern prefectures with Yang Ye as second-in-command, and the Yongxi offensive opened through Yanmen Pass.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，曹彬與契丹兵戰固安南，克其城。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guiyou, Cao Bin fought Khitan troops south of Gu'an and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the third month Cao Bin defeated the Khitan south of Gu'an and captured the town.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，田重進戰飛狐北，又破之。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Tian Chongjin fought north of Feihu and defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Tian Chongjin won another victory north of Feihu.

sentences.zh: 潘美自西陘入，與契丹兵遇，追至寰州，其刺史趙彥辛以城降。

translations.literal: Pan Mei entered by the western pass, met Khitan troops, pursued them to Huan prefecture, and its prefect Zhao Yanxin surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Mei came in by the western route, routed the Khitan to Huanzhou, and won the surrender of Prefect Zhao Yanxin.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，曹彬克涿州。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Cao Bin took Zhuo prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Cao Bin captured Zhuozhou.

sentences.zh: 潘美圍朔州，其節度副使趙希贊以城降。

translations.literal: Pan Mei besieged Shuo prefecture; its deputy military commissioner Zhao Xizan surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: Pan Mei invested Shuozhou until Deputy Commissioner Zhao Xizan opened the gates.

sentences.zh: 癸未，田重進戰飛狐北，獲其西南面招安使大鵬翼、康州刺史馬頵、馬軍指揮使何萬通。

translations.literal: On guimao, Tian Chongjin fought north of Feihu and captured their southwestern pacification commissioner Dapeng Yi, Kang prefecture commissioner Ma Yun, and cavalry commander He Wantong.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Tian Chongjin fought again north of Feihu and took the Khitan pacification commissioner Dapeng Yi, Kangzhou prefect Ma Yun, and cavalry commander He Wantong.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，曹彬敗契丹於涿州南，殺其相賀斯。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Cao Bin defeated the Khitan south of Zhuo prefecture and killed their chancellor Hes.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Cao Bin routed the Khitan below Zhuozhou and killed Chancellor Hes.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，潘美師至應州，其節度副使艾正、觀察判官宋雄以城降。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Pan Mei's army reached Ying prefecture; its deputy military commissioner Ai Zheng and observation commissioner Song Xiong surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Pan Mei reached Yingzhou, where Deputy Commissioner Ai Zheng and Judge Song Xiong surrendered.

sentences.zh: 司門員外郎王延範與秘書丞陸坦、戎城縣主簿田辯、術士劉昂坐謀不軌，棄市。

translations.literal: Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Yanfan, Secretariat aide Lu Tan, Rongcheng county registrar Tian Bian, and diviner Liu Ang, for plotting treason, were executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yanfan of the Department of State Affairs, Lu Tan, Tian Bian, and the diviner Liu Ang were beheaded for conspiracy.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，武寧軍節度使、同平章事、岐國公陳洪進卒。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Military Training and Pacification Army military commissioner and Associate Chief Councilor Duke of Qi Chen Hongjin died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Chen Hongjin, duke of Qi and commissioner of the Military Training army, died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，田重進攻飛狐，其守將呂行德、張繼從、劉知進等舉城降，以其縣為飛狐軍。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Tian Chongjin attacked Feihu; its defenders Lü Xingde, Zhang Jicong, Liu Zhijin, and others surrendered the city, and the county was made Feihu Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Tian Chongjin took Feihu when Lü Xingde and the other commanders capitulated; the county was elevated to Feihu Army.

sentences.zh: 占城國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Champa sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Champa dispatched tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙申，進圍靈丘，其守將穆超以城降。

translations.literal: On bingshen, he advanced to besiege Lingqiu; its defender Mu Chao surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he besieged Lingqiu until Defender Mu Chao yielded the town.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛丑，潘美克雲州。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on xinchou, Pan Mei took Yun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinchou, Pan Mei captured Yunzhou.

sentences.zh: 田重進戰飛狐北，破其眾。

translations.literal: Tian Chongjin fought north of Feihu and defeated their forces.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Chongjin won yet again north of Feihu.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，曹彬、米信戰新城東北，又破之。

translations.literal: On renyin, Cao Bin and Mi Xin fought northeast of Xincheng and defeated them again.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Cao Bin and Mi Xin routed the enemy northeast of Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 己酉，田重進再戰飛狐北，再破之，殺二將。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Tian Chongjin fought north of Feihu again and defeated them again, killing two generals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Tian Chongjin fought a third time at Feihu, broke the enemy again, and killed two generals.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，重進至蔚州，其牙校李存璋、許彥欽殺大將蕭啜理，執其監城使、同州節度使耿紹忠以城降。

translations.literal: On yimao, Chongjin reached Wei prefecture; its junior officers Li Cunzhang and Xu Yanqin killed the great general Xiao Chuoli and seized the garrison commissioner, Tong prefecture military commissioner Geng Shaozhong, surrendering the city.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, at Weizhou, Li Cunzhang and Xu Yanqin murdered the Khitan general Xiao Chuoli, seized Commissioner Geng Shaozhong, and opened the gates.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，曹彬之師大敗于岐溝關，收眾夜渡拒馬河，退屯易州，知幽州行府事劉保勳死之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu, Cao Bin's army suffered a great defeat at Qigou Pass, gathered the remnants that night and crossed the Juma River, withdrew to garrison at Yi prefecture, and Liu Baoqin, who held provisional authority over You prefecture, died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the fifth month Cao Bin was shattered at Qigou Pass, fled by night across the Juma, fell back on Yizhou, and Liu Baoqin, acting governor of Youzhou, was killed.

sentences.zh: 丙子，召曹彬、崔彥進、米信歸闕，命田重進屯定州，潘美還代州。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin were recalled to court; Tian Chongjin was ordered to garrison at Ding prefecture and Pan Mei to return to Dai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he recalled Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin while leaving Tian Chongjin at Dingzhou and sending Pan Mei back to Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 徙雲、應、寰、朔吏民及吐渾部族，分置河東、京西。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials and the Tuguhun tribes of Yun, Ying, Huan, and Shuo were relocated and settled in Hedong and Jingxi.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and Tuguhun clans from the captured prefectures were resettled across Hedong and the western capital region.

sentences.zh: 會契丹十萬眾復陷寰州，楊業護送遷民遇之，苦戰力盡，為所禽，守節而死。

translations.literal: When a Khitan force of one hundred thousand again took Huan prefecture, Yang Ye, escorting relocated civilians, met them, fought bitterly until his strength was spent, was captured, and died holding to his integrity.
translations.idiomatic: A hundred thousand Khitan retook Huanzhou; Yang Ye, guarding evacuees, fought to the last, was taken, and died rather than submit.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuxu, the new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon in the sixth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以御史中丞辛仲甫為參知政事。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Censor-in-Chief Xin Zhongfu was made Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he named censor-in-chief Xin Zhongfu a vice director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，貶曹彬為右驍衛上將軍，崔彥進為右武衛上將軍，米信為右屯衛上將軍，杜彥圭為均州團練使。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengwu, Cao Bin was demoted to Right Valiant Cavalry Grand General, Cui Yanjin to Right Martial Guard Grand General, Mi Xin to Right Garrison Guard Grand General, and Du Yankui to Jun prefecture military training commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu in the seventh month he stripped Cao Bin, Cui Yanjin, and Mi Xin of field commands and demoted Du Yankui to a training post at Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 應群臣、列校死事及陷敵者，錄其子孫。

translations.literal: For the hundred officials, ranked officers, and those who died in service or fell into enemy hands, their sons and grandsons were recorded for favor.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered registers drawn up to reward the kin of officials and officers killed or captured in the campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬午，徙山後降民至河南府、許汝等州。

translations.literal: On renwu, the surrendered peoples behind the mountains were moved to Henan prefecture, Xu, Ru, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he resettled mountain tribesmen in the central plain around Luoyang and the Xu-Ru region.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以簽署樞密院事張齊賢為給事中、知代州。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Zhang Qixian, who held provisional authority over the Bureau of Military Affairs, was made Director of the Department of State Affairs and given authority over Dai prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Zhang Qixian left the military bureau for a directorship and the governorship of Daizhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，階州福津縣有大山飛來，自龍帝峽壅江水逆流，壞民田數百里。

translations.literal: On guisi, in Jie prefecture's Fujin county a great mountain flew in, dammed the river at Longdi Gorge so the water ran backward, and ruined peasant fields for several hundred li.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi a landslide in Fujin county dammed the Longdi Gorge, threw the river into reverse, and destroyed farmland for hundreds of li.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔改陳王元祐為元僖，韓王元休為元侃，冀王元雋為元份。

translations.literal: On jiawu, an edict changed Prince of Chen Yuan You to Yuan Xi, Prince of Han Yuan Xiu to Yuan Kan, and Prince of Ji Yuan Jun to Yuan Fen.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he renamed his sons: Yuan You became Yuan Xi, Yuan Xiu became Yuan Kan, and Yuan Jun became Yuan Fen.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉朔，以王沔、張宏並為樞密副使。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on dingyou, the new-moon day, Wang Han and Zhang Hong were both made Deputy Commissioners of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou new moon in the eighth month Wang Han and Zhang Hong became deputy military commissioners.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大雨，遣使禱岳瀆，至夕雨止。

translations.literal: On dingwei, heavy rain fell; envoys were sent to pray at the sacred mountains and rivers, and by evening the rain stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei torrential rain fell until he sent prayers to the sacred peaks and rivers and the skies cleared by nightfall.

sentences.zh: 劍州民饑，遣使振之，因督捕諸州盜賊。

translations.literal: The people of Jian prefecture suffered famine; envoys were sent to relieve them and also to supervise the capture of bandits in the circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Famine hit Jianzhou; relief commissioners were sent out and ordered to hunt down bandits empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，降潘美為檢校太保，贈楊業太尉、大同軍節度使。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Pan Mei was demoted to Acting Grand Master and Yang Ye was posthumously made Grand Marshal and military commissioner of Datong Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Pan Mei was reduced in rank while Yang Ye was posthumously ennobled grand marshal and commissioner of Datong.

sentences.zh: 九月丙寅朔，減兩京諸州繫囚流以下一等，杖罪釋之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingyin, the new-moon day, prisoners in the two capitals and circuits sentenced to exile or below were reduced one grade, and those punished by the rod were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon in the ninth month he commuted exile sentences in the capitals and circuits and freed everyone punished by beating.

sentences.zh: 賜所徙寰、應、蔚等州民米，昇、宣等十四州雍熙二年官所振貸並蠲之。

translations.literal: Grain was bestowed on the people relocated from Huan, Ying, Wei, and other prefectures; grain loans made by the Yongxi year two government granaries in Sheng, Xuan, and fourteen other prefectures were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: He issued grain to evacuees from the northern prefectures and canceled every disaster loan the Yongxi granaries had made in fourteen southeastern circuits.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，賜北征軍士陣亡者家三月糧。

translations.literal: On wuyin, families of soldiers killed in the northern expedition were granted three months' grain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he gave three months' rations to the families of men killed in the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，以陳王元僖為開封尹。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiachen, Prince of Chen Yuan Xi was made Metropolitan Governor of Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen, Yuan Xi, Prince of Chen, became metropolitan governor of Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 壬子，高麗國王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On renzi, the king of Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the king of Goryeo sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔以權靜海軍留後黎桓為本軍節度。

translations.literal: On gengshen, an edict recognized Acting Jinghai Army Military Commissioner Li Huan as full commissioner of that army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he confirmed Li Huan as military commissioner of the Jinghai army in Jiaozhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，幸建隆觀、相國寺祈雪。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingxu, he visited Jianlong Abbey and Xiangguo Monastery to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the eleventh month he prayed for snow at Jianlong Abbey and Xiangguo Monastery.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未朔，大雨雪，宴群臣玉華殿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yiwei, the new-moon day, heavy snow fell; the hundred officials were feasted in Jade Splendor Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei new moon in the twelfth month a blizzard swept the capital and he banqueted the court in Jade Splendor Hall.

sentences.zh: 己亥，定州田重進入契丹界，攻下岐溝關。

translations.literal: On jihai, Ding prefecture's Tian Chongjin entered Khitan territory and took Qigou Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Tian Chongjin crossed the border and recaptured Qigou Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，契丹敗劉廷讓軍於君子館，執先鋒將賀令圖，高陽關部署楊重進死之。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Khitan defeated Liu Tingrang's army at Junzi Lodge, captured the vanguard general He Lingtu, and Gaoyang Pass deployment commissioner Yang Chongjin died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Khitan crushed Liu Tingrang at Junzi Lodge, seized General He Lingtu, and killed Yang Chongjin at Gaoyang Pass.

sentences.zh: 壬子，建房州為保康軍，以右衛上將軍劉繼元為節度使。

translations.literal: On renzi, Fang prefecture was made Baokang Army, and Right Garrison Guard Grand General Liu Jiyuan was made its military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he elevated Fangzhou to Baokang Army command and named Liu Jiyuan its commissioner.

sentences.zh: 代州副部署盧漢贇敗契丹於土鐙堡，斬獲甚眾，殺監軍舍利二人。

translations.literal: Dai prefecture deputy deployment commissioner Lu Hanyun defeated the Khitan at Tudeng Fort, took many heads and captives, and killed two supervising commissioners Shel.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Hanyun, deputy at Daizhou, routed the Khitan at Tudeng Fort, took heavy booty, and killed two Khitan overseers named Shel.

sentences.zh: 是歲，壽州大水，濮州蝗。

translations.literal: That year, Shou prefecture suffered great flood; Pu prefecture locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods devastated Shouzhou and locusts swarmed Pu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月甲子朔，不受朝，群臣詣閤拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: In year four, spring, first month, on jiazi, the new-moon day, he did not hold audience; the hundred officials went to the palace gate to present congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi new moon in the first month of Yongxi year four he skipped court and received New Year felicitations at the palace gate.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣使按問西川、嶺南、江、浙等路刑獄。

translations.literal: On jimao, envoys were dispatched to review criminal cases on the Sichuan, Lingnan, Jiang, and Zhe routes.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he sent commissioners to audit prisons across Sichuan, Lingnan, and the lower Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔：「應行營將士戰敗潰散者並釋不問，緣邊城堡備禦有勞可紀者所在以聞。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict stated: "Field-army officers and soldiers who were defeated and scattered are all to be released without inquiry; border fortresses and garrisons that defended with merit worthy of record—let each place report.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he proclaimed: "Routed soldiers of the field armies will not be punished; every border post that held with distinction should report up.

sentences.zh: 瘞暴骸，死事者廩給其家，錄死事文武官子孫。

translations.literal: Bury the exposed dead; for those who died in service provide grain rations to their families and record the sons and grandsons of civil and military officials who died in service.
translations.idiomatic: Bury the unburied dead, feed the families of the fallen, and enroll their sons and grandsons for office.

sentences.zh: 蠲河北雍熙三年以前逋租，敵所蹂踐者給復三年，軍所過二年，餘一年。」

translations.literal: Remit Hebei arrears of rent before Yongxi year three; where the enemy trampled, grant tax relief for three years, where armies passed two years, elsewhere one year."
translations.idiomatic: Cancel Hebei back rent before Yongxi year three, grant three years' relief where the Khitan marched, two where our armies passed, and one everywhere else."

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，以漢南國王錢俶為武勝軍節度使，徙封南陽國王。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingshen, King of the Han Southern State Qian Chu was made Military Training Army military commissioner and transferred to be enfeoffed as King of Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the second month Qian Chu, king of Wuyue, became commissioner of the Military Training army and was re-enfeoffed as King of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，繕治河北諸州、軍城隍。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the walls and moats of Hebei prefectures and armies were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou he ordered the walls and moats of every Hebei garrison rebuilt.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，錢俶改封許王。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Qian Chu was again enfeoffed as King of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Qian Chu received the new title King of Xu.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，詔申嚴考績。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengchen, an edict strictly enforced performance review.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the third month he tightened the civil-service evaluation system.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳朔，以御史中丞趙昌言為右諫議大夫、樞密副使。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guisi, the new-moon day, Censor-in-Chief Zhao Changyan was made Right Remonstrance Clerk and Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi new moon in the fourth month of summer Zhao Changyan became right remonstrance clerk and deputy military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔：諸州郡暑月五日一滌囹圄，給飲漿，病者令醫治，小罪即決之。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict stated: In the fifth month of summer in each prefecture and commandery, the prison is to be cleansed every five days, drink provided, the sick treated by physicians, and minor offenses decided at once.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he ordered every jail scrubbed every five days in summer, prisoners given drink and doctors, and petty cases disposed on the spot.

sentences.zh: 丁未，幸金明池觀水嬉，遂習射瓊林苑，登樓，擲金錢繒彩於樓下，縱民取之。

translations.literal: On dingwei, he visited Golden Bright Pool to watch water games, then practiced archery in Jade Forest Garden, ascended a tower, and threw gold coins and silks down to the crowd below for the people to take.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he watched boat races at Golden Bright Pool, shot in Jade Forest Garden, and showered gold and silk from a tower for the crowd to scramble after.

sentences.zh: 並水陸發運為一司。

translations.literal: Water and land transport commissions were merged into one office.
translations.idiomatic: He united the water and land grain transport bureaus into a single agency.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，遣使市諸道民馬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingyin, envoys were dispatched to purchase horses from the people in each circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the fifth month he sent buyers to acquire horses from commoners in every circuit.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，改殿前司日騎為捧日，驍猛為拱辰，雄勇為神勇，上鐵林為殿前司虎翼，腰弩為神射，侍衛步軍司鐵林為侍衛司虎翼。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Palace Front Daily Cavalry was renamed Sun-Bearer, Valiant Fierce became Bowed Star, Valiant Brave became Divine Brave, Upper Iron Forest became Palace Front Tiger Wing, Waist Crossbow became Divine Archer, and the Attendant Infantry Iron Forest became Attendant Tiger Wing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he renamed palace guard units: Daily Cavalry to Sun-Bearer, Valiant Fierce to Bowed Star, and a string of other ceremonial titles for the elite corps.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔諸州送醫術人校業太醫署。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict ordered each prefecture to send medical practitioners to the Imperial Medical Service for examination.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he required every prefecture to send physicians to the Imperial Medical Service for licensing exams.

sentences.zh: 賜諸將陣圖。

translations.literal: Battle array diagrams were bestowed on the generals.
translations.idiomatic: He distributed tactical diagrams to his field commanders.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，以右驍衛上將軍劉廷讓為雄州都部署。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingyou, Right Valiant Cavalry Grand General Liu Tingrang was made overall deployment commissioner of Xiong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the sixth month Liu Tingrang, lately demoted, was posted as supreme commander at Xiongzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以彰國軍節度使、駙馬都尉王承衍為貝、冀都部署，郭守文及郢州團練使田欽祚並為北面排陣使。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Zhangguo Army military commissioner and Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Wang Chengyan was made overall deployment commissioner of Bei and Ji prefectures; Guo Shouwen and Ying prefecture training commissioner Tian Qinzuo were both made northern battle-array commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Wang Chengyan took Bei and Ji while Guo Shouwen and Tian Qinzuo were named northern battle commissioners.

sentences.zh: 庚子，定國軍節度使崔翰復為高陽關兵馬都部署。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Dingguo Army military commissioner Cui Han was again made overall deployment commissioner of Gaoyang Pass troops and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Cui Han returned to command the Gaoyang Pass armies.

sentences.zh: 是月，鄜州獻馬，前足如牛。

translations.literal: That month, Fu prefecture presented a horse whose forelegs were like an ox's.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fuzhou sent up a horse with ox-like forelegs as a curiosity.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅，幸講武池觀魚。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingyin, he visited the Lecture-on-Military-Affairs Pool to view the fish.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the seventh month he went to the Boat-Training Pool to watch the fish.

sentences.zh: 是月，置三班院。

translations.literal: That month, the Three-Rank Court was established.
translations.idiomatic: That month he founded the Three-Rank Court for scheduling imperial audiences.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，免諸州吏所逋京倉米二十六萬七千石。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengzi, the 267,000 shi of capital-granary rice owed by officials in the circuits was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he canceled 267,000 shi of capital-granary rice debt owed by circuit officials.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，校醫術人，優者為翰林學生。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on guihai, medical practitioners were examined; the superior were made Hanlin students.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he tested physicians and admitted the best to the Hanlin medical academy.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙午，流雄州都部署劉廷讓於商州。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on bingwu, Xiong prefecture deployment commissioner Liu Tingrang was exiled to Shang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the tenth month Liu Tingrang was banished to Shangzhou after another northern setback.

sentences.zh: 壬子，左僕射致仕沈倫薨。

translations.literal: On renzi, Left Vice Director retired-from-office Shen Lun died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the retired former chief minister Shen Lun died.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚辰，詔以實數給百官奉。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengchen, an edict ordered that officials' salaries be paid in full according to actual amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he decreed that bureaucrats receive their full nominal salaries in cash.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬寅，幸建隆觀、相國寺祈雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renyin, he visited Jianlong Abbey and Xiangguo Monastery to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the twelfth month he again prayed for snow at Jianlong Abbey and Xiangguo Monastery.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，畋近郊。

translations.literal: On gengxu, he hunted near the suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he hunted outside the capital walls.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，大雨雪。

translations.literal: On dingsi, heavy snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi a heavy snowfall blanketed the capital.

sentences.zh: 端拱元年春正月己未朔，不受朝，群臣詣閤拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: In Duan Gong year one, spring, first month, on jiwei, the new-moon day, he did not hold audience; the hundred officials went to the palace gate to present congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon in the first month of Duan Gong year one he skipped court and received New Year greetings at the gate.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，親耕籍田。

translations.literal: On yihai, he personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he performed the spring plowing rite at the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 還御丹鳳樓，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: Returning, he held court at Crimson Phoenix Tower, proclaimed a great amnesty, and changed the reign era.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to Crimson Phoenix Tower, proclaimed a general amnesty, and inaugurated the Duan Gong era.

sentences.zh: 除十惡、官吏犯贓至殺人者不赦外，民年七十以上賜爵一級。

translations.literal: Except for the ten abominations and official corruption down to murder, all were pardoned; commoners seventy years of age and above were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: The amnesty spared only capital crimes and corruption; every subject over seventy received a noble rank.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸玉津園習射。

translations.literal: On guimao, he visited Jade Ford Garden to practice archery.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he shot at Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，禁用酷刑。

translations.literal: On yiyou, cruel punishments were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he banned torture in judicial interrogation.

sentences.zh: 是月，澶州黃河清。

translations.literal: That month, the Yellow River at Tan prefecture ran clear.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River at Tanzhou ran clear—another heaven-sent sign.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，改左、右補闕為左、右司諫，左、右拾遺為左、右正言。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yiwei, Left and Right Remonstrance Clerks were changed to Left and Right Director of Remonstrance, and Left and Right Drafters to Left and Right Rectifier of Omissions.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the second month he retitled the remonstrance and drafting posts to the Duan Gong nomenclature.

sentences.zh: 丙申，禁諸州獻珍禽奇獸。

translations.literal: On bingshen, the circuits' presentation of rare birds and exotic beasts was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he forbade the circuits from sending tribute of rare animals.

sentences.zh: 己亥，詔瀛州民為敵所侵暴者賜三年租，復其役五年。

translations.literal: On jihai, an edict granted three years' rent to the people of Ying prefecture ravaged by the enemy and remitted their labor service for five years.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he gave three years' free rent and five years without corvée to Yingzhou families plundered by the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以籍田，開封尹、陳王元僖進封許王，元侃襄王，元份越王，錢俶鄧王，中書門下平章事李昉為尚書右僕射，參知政事呂蒙正同中書門下平章事，樞密使王顯加檢校太傅，給事中許國公趙普守太保兼侍中，參加政事辛仲甫加戶部侍郎，樞密副使趙昌言加工部侍郎，樞密副使王沔為參知政事，御史中丞張宏為樞密副使，餘內外並加恩。

translations.literal: On gengzi, because of the plowing rite, Metropolitan Governor and Prince of Chen Yuan Xi was advanced to Prince of Xu, Yuan Kan to Prince of Xiang, Yuan Fen to Prince of Yue, Qian Chu to Prince of Deng, Associate Chief Councilor Li Fang to Right Vice Director, Vice Director Lü Mengzheng to Associate Chief Councilor, Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Xian promoted to Acting Grand Master, Director of the Department of State Affairs and Duke of Xu Zhao Pu kept as Grand Master and Palace Attendant, Vice Director Xin Zhongfu promoted to Minister of Revenue, Deputy Commissioner Zhao Changyan to Minister of Works, Deputy Commissioner Wang Han made Vice Director, Censor-in-Chief Zhang Hong made Deputy Commissioner, and the rest within and without all received grace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, celebrating the plowing rite, he ennobled his sons and allies—Yuan Xi became Prince of Xu, Qian Chu Prince of Deng—and promoted Li Fang, Lü Mengzheng, Zhao Pu, and a slate of military and civil officers.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，升建州為建寧軍節度。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Jian prefecture was elevated to Jianning Army command.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen he elevated Jianzhou to Jianning Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以子元偓為左衛上將軍、徐國公，元偁為右衛上將軍、涇國公。

translations.literal: On gengxu, his son Yuan Wei was made Left Garrison Guard Grand General and Duke of Xu; Yuan Cheng Right Garrison Guard Grand General and Duke of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu his sons Yuan Wei and Yuan Cheng received grand generalships and the ducal titles of Xu and Jing.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，貶樞密副使趙昌言為崇信軍行軍司馬。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiaxu, Deputy Commissioner Zhao Changyan was demoted to Chongxin Army itinerant commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the third month Zhao Changyan was exiled to a staff post at Chongxin.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，鄭州團練使侯莫陳利用坐不法，配商州禁錮，尋賜死。

translations.literal: On yihai, Ying prefecture training commissioner Hou Mochen Liyong, for unlawful conduct, was assigned to confinement at Shang prefecture and soon granted death.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the sorcerer-official Hou Mochen Liyong was imprisoned at Shangzhou and then ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 癸未，幸玉津園習射。

translations.literal: On guimao, he visited Jade Ford Garden to practice archery.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he shot again at Jade Ford Garden.

sentences.zh: 廢水陸發運司。

translations.literal: The combined water and land transport commission was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: He dissolved the unified transport bureau he had created two years before.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁亥，賜京城高年帛。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dinghai, cloth was bestowed on the elderly of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the fourth month of summer he gave cloth to the capital's aged poor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，加高麗國王治、靜海軍節度使黎桓並檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On jichou, King Zhì of Goryeo and Jinghai Army military commissioner Li Huan were both promoted to Acting Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he promoted the Goryeo king and Li Huan of Jiaozhou to acting grand master.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，置秘閤於崇文院。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on xinyou, a Secret Pavilion was established within the Hall for Exalted Literature.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the fifth month he opened a Secret Pavilion inside the Hall for Exalted Literature.

sentences.zh: 辛未，感德軍節度使李繼捧賜姓趙氏，名保忠。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Pacification Army military commissioner Li Jibing was granted the surname Zhao and the name Baozhong.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Jibing of the Tangut border was adopted into the imperial clan as Zhao Baozhong.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以保忠為定難軍節度使。

translations.literal: On renshen, Baozhong was made Dingnan Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Zhao Baozhong became commissioner of the Dingnan army at Xiazhou.

sentences.zh: 閏五月辛卯，以洺州防禦使劉福為高陽關兵馬都部署，濮州防禦使楊贊為貝州兵馬都部署。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month, on xinmao, Luozhou defense commissioner Liu Fu was made overall deployment commissioner of Gaoyang Pass troops and horses, and Puzhou defense commissioner Yang Zan overall deployment commissioner of Bei prefecture troops and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month Liu Fu took Gaoyang Pass and Yang Zan took Bei prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賜諸州高年爵公士。

translations.literal: On yiwei, the elderly of the circuits were granted the noble rank of Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he granted the rank of gentleman to the aged in every circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，交州黎桓遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Jiaozhou's Li Huan sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Li Huan of Jiaozhou sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，親試禮部進士及下第舉人。

translations.literal: On renyin, he personally examined presented scholars of the Ministry of Rites and examination candidates who had failed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he personally tested jinshi graduates and men who had failed the civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 六月丙辰朔，右領軍衛大將軍陳廷山謀反伏誅。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingchen, the new-moon day, Right Leading Guard Grand General Chen Tingshan, for plotting rebellion, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon in the sixth month Chen Tingshan, a right leading guard general, was executed for treason.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，改湖南節度為武安軍節度。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Hunan circuit was changed to Wu'an Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he redesignated Hunan circuit as Wu'an Army.

sentences.zh: 親試進士諸科舉人。

translations.literal: He personally examined presented scholars and candidates of all examination categories.
translations.idiomatic: He again presided in person over the jinshi and specialist civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙午，除西川諸州鹽禁。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingwu, the salt prohibition in Sichuan circuits was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the seventh month he ended the state salt monopoly in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，忠武軍節度使潘美知鎮州。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Loyal and Martial Army military commissioner Pan Mei was given authority over Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Pan Mei was assigned to govern Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉朔，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使李繼隆為定州都部署。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on yiyou, the new-moon day, Attendant Cavalry Commander Li Jilong was made overall deployment commissioner of Ding prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou new moon in the ninth month Li Jilong, commander of the palace cavalry, took supreme command at Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，以侍衛步軍都指揮使戴興為澶州都部署。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renwu, Attendant Infantry Commander Dai Xing was made overall deployment commissioner of Tan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the tenth month Dai Xing, commander of the palace infantry, was posted to Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，詔罷游獵，五方所畜鷹犬並放之，諸州毋以為獻。

translations.literal: On guimao, an edict abolished the hunt; hawks and hounds kept in the five directions were all released, and the circuits were forbidden to present them.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he banned imperial hunting, released every hawk and hound in the palace mews, and forbade the circuits from sending more.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申朔，高麗王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiashen, the new-moon day, the king of Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon in the eleventh month the king of Goryeo sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 己丑，郭守文破契丹于唐河。

translations.literal: On jichou, Guo Shouwen defeated the Khitan on the Tang River.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Guo Shouwen routed the Khitan on the Tang River.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，以夏州蕃落使李繼遷為銀州刺史，充洛苑使。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinwei, Xiazhou tribal commissioner Li Jiqian was made Yin prefecture commissioner and appointed Luoyuan Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Jiqian, the Tangut leader, was named commissioner of Yinzhou and superintendent of the imperial stud farms.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸未朔，不受朝，群臣詣閤拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: In year two, spring, first month, on guimao, the new-moon day, he did not hold audience; the hundred officials went to the palace gate to present congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon in the first month of Duan Gong year two he skipped court for the New Year.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以涪州觀察使柴禹錫為澶州兵馬部署。

translations.literal: On renchen, Fu prefecture observation commissioner Chai Yuxi was made Tan prefecture troop deployment commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Chai Yuxi moved from Fuzhou to command the armies at Tanzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔議北伐。

translations.literal: On guisi, an edict ordered discussion of a northern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi he ordered the court to debate another invasion of the north.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子朔，令河北東、西路招置營田。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renzi, the new-moon day, an edict ordered Hebei East and West circuits to establish garrison farms.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon in the second month he ordered military colonies planted across Hebei.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔錄將校官吏功及死事使臣、官吏子孫，士卒廩給其家三月。

translations.literal: On guichou, an edict ordered that the sons and grandsons of ranked officers, officials, and envoys who achieved merit or died in service be recorded, and that soldiers' families receive three months' grain.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he renewed rewards for campaign dead—office for officers' heirs and three months' grain for common soldiers' families.

sentences.zh: 平塞、天威、平定、威虜、靜戎、保塞、寧邊等軍，祁、易、保、定、鎮、邢、趙等州民，除雍熙四年正月丙戌詔給復外，更給復二年；

translations.literal: For the people of Pingsai, Tianwei, Pingding, Weilu, Jingrong, Baosai, Ningbian, and other armies and Qi, Yi, Bao, Ding, Zhen, Xing, Zhao, and other prefectures, beyond the tax relief granted by the Yongxi year four first-month bingxu edict, two more years of relief were granted;
translations.idiomatic: Beyond the Yongxi year four amnesty, he granted two more years without tax to the border armies and the Qi-Yi-Bao-Ding-Zhen-Xing-Zhao prefectures;

sentences.zh: 霸、代、洺、雄、莫、深等州，平虜、岢嵐軍，更給復一年。

translations.literal: for Ba, Dai, Ming, Xiong, Mo, Shen, and other prefectures and Pinglu and Kelan armies, one more year of relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: and one further year to Ba, Dai, Ming, Xiong, Mo, Shen, and the Pinglu and Kelan garrisons.

sentences.zh: 戊午，罷乘傳銀牌，復給樞密院牒。

translations.literal: On wuwu, the silver tallies for imperial relay travel were abolished and documents from the Bureau of Military Affairs were again issued.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he ended the silver relay-pass system and restored military-bureau travel warrants.

sentences.zh: 乙太倉粟貸京畿饑民。

translations.literal: Great-granary grain was lent to feed the starving of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: He opened the state granaries to feed famine victims around the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，作方田。

translations.literal: On guihai, the square-field system was instituted.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he launched the square-field land-survey reform.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以國子監為國子學。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the Directorate of Education was made the National University.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he elevated the Directorate of Education to a National University.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，命高瓊為并代都部署。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinmao, Gao Qiong was made overall deployment commissioner of Bing and Dai.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the third month Gao Qiong took supreme command of Bing and Dai prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，親試禮部舉人。

translations.literal: On renyin, he personally examined the Ministry of Rites examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he again presided over the civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，置富順監。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dingsi, Fushun Directorate was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi, he founded the Fushun salt directorate.

sentences.zh: 辛未，幸趙普第視疾。

translations.literal: On xinwei, he visited Zhao Pu's residence to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he called at Zhao Pu's house to visit the dying statesman.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，以旱慮囚，遣使決諸道獄。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wuxu, because of drought prisoners were reviewed; envoys were sent to decide cases in each circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the fifth month drought moved him to review capital prisoners and dispatch commissioners to clear dockets empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 是夕，雨。

translations.literal: That evening, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that night.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲申，以知代州張齊賢為刑部侍郎、樞密副使，鹽鐵使張遜為宣徽北院使、簽署樞密院事。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jiashen, Zhang Qixian, who held authority over Dai prefecture, was made Minister of Justice and Deputy Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Salt and Iron Commissioner Zhang Xun was made Commissioner of the North Palace of the Palace Domestic Service and given provisional authority over the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the seventh month Zhang Qixian left Daizhou for the ministry of justice and a military deputyship, while Zhang Xun of the salt monopoly joined the privy council.

sentences.zh: 戊子，有彗出東井，上避正殿，減常膳。

translations.literal: On wuzi, a comet appeared at the Well constellation; the Emperor avoided the main hall and reduced his regular meals.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi a comet blazed in the Well; Taizong moved court to a side hall and cut his own rations.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，契丹犯威虜軍，崇儀使尹繼倫擊破之，殺其相皮室，大將于越遁去。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Khitan attacked Weilu Army; Honored Ritual Commissioner Yin Jilun defeated them, killed their chancellor Pishi, and the great general Yuyue fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Khitan struck Weilu; Yin Jilun routed them, killed Chancellor Pishi, and drove General Yuyue from the field.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，大赦，是夕，彗不見。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingchen, a great amnesty was proclaimed; that evening the comet was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the eighth month he proclaimed a general amnesty, and the comet vanished that night.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔作開寶寺舍利塔成。

translations.literal: On guihai, an edict announced the completion of the relic pagoda at Kaibao Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he announced that Kaibao Monastery's relic pagoda was finished.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，邛部川、山後百蠻來貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renwu, the Qiong tribal chieftaincy and the hundred barbarian peoples behind the mountains came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the ninth month Qiong tribesmen and mountain peoples beyond the frontier presented tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，以定難軍節度使趙保忠同平章事。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on xinwei, Dingnan Army military commissioner Zhao Baozhong was made Associate Chief Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the tenth month Zhao Baozhong of Xiazhou joined the council of chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 以歲旱、彗星謫見，詔曰：「朕以身為犧牲，焚於烈火，亦未足以答謝天譴。

translations.literal: Because of drought and the appearance of a baleful comet, an edict stated: "We would offer our body as sacrifice and burn it in blazing fire, yet that would not suffice to answer heaven's reproof.
translations.idiomatic: Facing drought and the comet, he issued an edict: "Were I to burn myself alive as an offering, heaven's anger would still not be appeased.

sentences.zh: 當與卿等審刑政之闕失、稼穡之艱難，恤物安人，以祈玄祐。」

translations.literal: We must with you examine the gaps in criminal governance and the hardships of the harvest, comfort things and settle the people, to seek dark blessing."
translations.idiomatic: Let us search out failures of justice and the misery of the fields, ease the people's burdens, and pray for heaven's mercy."

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥，置三司都磨勘官。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinhai, the Three Commissions Chief Auditor was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the twelfth month he created the chief auditor for the three fiscal commissions.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，大雨雪。

translations.literal: On bingchen, heavy snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen a heavy blizzard struck.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔令四方所上表祗稱皇帝。

translations.literal: On gengshen, an edict ordered that memorials from the four directions address only "Emperor."
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he required every provincial memorial to address him simply as "Emperor," without flowery epithets.

sentences.zh: 群臣請復尊號，不許。

translations.literal: The hundred officials requested that the honorific title be restored; this was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The court petitioned to restore his full honorific titles, and he refused.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上法天崇道文武皇帝，詔去「文武」二字，餘許之。

translations.literal: On xinyou, he took the title Emperor in Accordance with Heaven, Revering the Way, Martial and Cultured; an edict removed the words "Martial and Cultured," and the rest was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he accepted Emperor in Accordance with Heaven, Revering the Way—but struck the words Martial and Cultured from the style.

sentences.zh: 三佛齊國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The Srivijaya state sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Srivijaya dispatched tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 淳化元年春正月戊寅朔，減京畿繫囚流罪以下一等。

translations.literal: In Chunhua year one, spring, first month, on wuyin, prisoners in the capital region sentenced to exile or below were reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the first month of Chunhua year one he commuted exile sentences in the capital region by one degree.

sentences.zh: 改元，內外文武官並加勳階爵邑，中書舍人、大將軍以上各賜一子官。

translations.literal: The reign era was changed; civil and military officials within and without all received merit ranks, noble titles, and fiefs; Secretariat Drafters, Grand Generals, and above each had one son granted office.
translations.idiomatic: He inaugurated the Chunhua era, showered rank and fiefs on the bureaucracy, and granted an office to one son of every drafter and grand general and above.

sentences.zh: 賜鰥寡孤獨錢，除逋負。

translations.literal: Money was bestowed on widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary; arrears were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: He gave cash to the destitute and canceled private debts owed to the state.

sentences.zh: 受尊號，改乾明節為壽寧節。

translations.literal: He received the honorific title and changed Qianming Festival to Shouning Festival.
translations.idiomatic: He accepted his court honorific and renamed the imperial birthday from Qianming to Shouning.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔作清心殿。

translations.literal: On wuzi, an edict ordered construction of the Clear Heart Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi he ordered the Clear Heart Hall built.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未朔，除江南、兩浙、淮西、嶺南諸州漁禁。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingwei, the new-moon day, the fishing prohibition in Jiangnan, the Two Zhes, Huaixi, and Lingnan circuits was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon in the second month he opened fishing grounds across the southeast and south.

sentences.zh: 己酉，改大明殿為含光殿。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Great Bright Hall was renamed Radiant Light Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he renamed Great Bright Hall as Radiant Light Hall.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子朔。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingzi, the new-moon day.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon in the third month.

sentences.zh: 乙未，幸西京留守趙普第視疾。

translations.literal: On yiwei, he visited the residence of Western Capital regent Zhao Pu to inquire after his illness.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he called at Zhao Pu's home in Luoyang, where the former chief minister lay ill.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，遣中使詣五嶽禱雨，慮囚，遣使分決諸道獄。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on gengxu, he dispatched palace envoys to the Five Sacred Peaks to pray for rain, reviewed prisoners, and sent envoys to adjudicate prisons in each circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengxu, he sent eunuchs to pray for rain at the Five Peaks, held a prison review at court, and dispatched commissioners to clear the dockets circuit by circuit.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔尚書省四品、兩省五品以上舉轉運使及知州、通判。

translations.literal: On jiayin, an edict ordered Secretariat officials of the fourth rank and above and Secretariat-Chancellery officials of the fifth rank and above to recommend transport commissioners, prefectural administrators, and military-civil controllers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he told fourth-rank Secretariat officers and fifth-rank Secretariat-Chancellery officers to nominate transport commissioners, prefects, and controllers.

sentences.zh: 五溪蠻田漢權來附。

translations.literal: Five Streams Man chief Tian Hanquan came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Hanquan of the Five Streams tribes presented his allegiance.

sentences.zh: 戊午，建婺州為保寧軍節度。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Wu prefecture was made Baoning Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he elevated Wu prefecture to Baoning Army command.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，命殿前副都指揮使戴興為鎮州都部署。

translations.literal: On bingyin, he ordered Vice Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Front Dai Xing to be Zhenzhou commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he named Palace Front vice commander Dai Xing commander-in-chief at Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，給致仕官半奉。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jiawu, retired officials were granted half salary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiawu, he paid half stipends to officials in retirement.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，置詳覆、推勘官。

translations.literal: On xinmao, detailed review and investigation officers were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he created posts for judicial review and special investigation.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，罷中元、下元張燈。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingwu, mid-autumn and late-autumn lantern displays were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingwu, he ended the mid- and late-autumn palace lantern festivals.

sentences.zh: 庚午，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁丑，太白復見。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on dingchou, Venus appeared again.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingchou, Venus showed again in daylight.

sentences.zh: 是月，吉、洪、江、蘄、河陽、隴城大水。

translations.literal: That month, Ji, Hong, Jiang, Qi, Heyang, and Longcheng suffered great floods.
translations.idiomatic: That month great floods struck Ji, Hong, Jiang, Qi, Heyang, and Longcheng.

sentences.zh: 開封、陳留、封丘、酸棗、鄢陵旱，賜今年田租之半，開封特給復一年。

translations.literal: Kaifeng, Chenliu, Fengqiu, Suanzao, and Yanling suffered drought; half this year's land tax was remitted, and Kaifeng was granted an extra full year's exemption.
translations.idiomatic: Drought gripped Kaifeng, Chenliu, Fengqiu, Suanzao, and Yanling; he cut their land tax in half for the year and gave Kaifeng a second full remission.

sentences.zh: 京師貴糴，遣使開廩減價分糶。

translations.literal: Grain was dear in the capital; envoys were sent to open granaries, cut prices, and sell grain in allotments.
translations.idiomatic: As food prices soared in the capital he opened the state granaries and sold grain at reduced rates.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，毀左藏庫金銀器皿。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on yisi, gold and silver vessels in the Left Treasury were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yisi, he ordered the destruction of gold and silver ware in the Left Treasury.

sentences.zh: 己巳，禁川峽、嶺南、湖南殺人祀鬼，州縣察捕，募告者賞之。

translations.literal: On jisi, killing people to sacrifice to ghosts was forbidden in Sichuan gorges, Lingnan, and Hunan; prefectures and counties were to investigate and arrest, and informants were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he outlawed human sacrifice in Sichuan, Lingnan, and Hunan, ordered local officials to hunt down offenders, and offered bounties to informers.

sentences.zh: 庚午，西南蕃主使其子龍漢興來貢。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the Southwestern Barbarians' ruler sent his son Long Hanxing to present tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the southwestern chieftain sent his son Long Hanxing to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，京兆長安八縣旱，賜今年租十之六。

translations.literal: That month, the eight counties of Jingzhao and Chang'an suffered drought; six-tenths of this year's rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month drought struck the eight counties of Jingzhao and Chang'an, and he remitted six-tenths of their annual rent.

sentences.zh: 蠲舒州宿松等三處魚池稅。

translations.literal: Fish-pond tax in Susong and two other districts of Shuzhou was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished the fish-pond levy in Susong and two other Shuzhou districts.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，熒惑入太微垣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinsi, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinsi, Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 大宴崇政殿。

translations.literal: A great banquet was held in Chongzheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: He hosted a grand feast in Chongzheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 禁川峽民父母在出為贅婿。

translations.literal: Sichuan gorge people whose parents were alive were forbidden to leave home as uxorilocal sons-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: He barred men in the Sichuan gorges from leaving their parents' home to marry in as live-in sons-in-law.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲滄、單、汝三州今年租十之六。

translations.literal: That month, six-tenths of this year's rent was remitted in Cang, Shan, and Ru prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: That month he remitted six-tenths of the annual rent in Cang, Shan, and Ru.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，交州黎桓遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiachen, Jiaozhou's Li Huan sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiachen, Li Huan of Jiaozhou dispatched tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，熒惑陵左執法。

translations.literal: On yisi, Mars crossed the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Mars passed the Left Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，知白州蔣元振、知須城縣姚益恭並以清幹聞，下詔褒諭，賜粟帛。

translations.literal: On yichou, Baizhou administrator Jiang Yuanzhen and Xucheng county magistrate Yao Yigong were both famed for integrity; an edict praised them and bestowed grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he issued a commendation and gifts of grain and silk to Baizhou prefect Jiang Yuanzhen and Xucheng magistrate Yao Yigong, both celebrated for clean government.

sentences.zh: 是月，以乾鄭二州、河南壽安等十四縣旱，州蠲今年租十之四，縣蠲其稅。

translations.literal: That month, because Qian and Zheng prefectures and fourteen counties including Henan Shou'an suffered drought, the prefectures had four-tenths of this year's rent remitted and the counties had their tax remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month drought in Qian and Zheng and fourteen counties such as Shou'an in Henan brought a four-tenths rent cut for the prefectures and full county tax relief.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，太白晝見。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, Venus was seen in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 是月，蠲大名府管內今年租十之七。

translations.literal: That month, seven-tenths of this year's rent within Daming prefecture was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: That month he remitted seven-tenths of the annual rent throughout Daming prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，占城遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on yisi, Champa sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on yisi, Champa dispatched tribute bearers.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，高麗國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On maomao, Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On maomao envoys arrived from Goryeo with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔中外所上書疏及面奏制可者，並下中書、樞密、三司中覆頒行。

translations.literal: On xinyou, an edict ordered that memorials and face-to-face proposals approved by the throne were all to be sent to the Secretariat, Bureau of Military Affairs, and Fiscal Commission for secondary review before promulgation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he required every approved memorial and oral proposal to pass Secretariat, Military Affairs, and Fiscal Commission review before issue.

sentences.zh: 是歲，洪、吉、江、蘄諸州水，河陽大水。

translations.literal: That year, Hong, Ji, Jiang, and Qi prefectures suffered floods, and Heyang a great flood.
translations.idiomatic: That year floods hit Hong, Ji, Jiang, and Qi, and Heyang was inundated.

sentences.zh: 曹、單二州有蝗，不為災。

translations.literal: Cao and Shan prefectures had locusts but suffered no disaster.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts appeared in Cao and Shan but did no harm.

sentences.zh: 開封、大名管內及許、滄、單、汝、乾、鄭等州，壽安、長安、天興等二十七縣旱。

translations.literal: Drought struck within Kaifeng and Daming and in Xu, Cang, Shan, Ru, Qian, Zheng, and other prefectures, and twenty-seven counties including Shou'an, Chang'an, and Tianxing.
translations.idiomatic: Drought afflicted Kaifeng, Daming, Xu, Cang, Shan, Ru, Qian, Zheng, and twenty-seven counties from Shou'an to Chang'an and Tianxing.

sentences.zh: 深冀二州、文登牟平兩縣饑。

translations.literal: Shen and Ji prefectures and Wendeng and Mouping counties suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: Famine gripped Shen and Ji and the counties of Wendeng and Mouping.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月壬申朔，不受朝，群臣詣閤拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: In year two, spring, first month, on renshen, the new-moon day, he did not hold audience; the hundred officials went to the side hall to present congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the renshen new moon in the first month of Chunhua year two he withheld court audience while officials offered New Year felicitations at the side hall.

sentences.zh: 丙子，遣商州團練使翟守素帥兵援趙保忠于夏州。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he dispatched Shangzhou regiment commander Zhai Shousu to lead troops to relieve Zhao Baozhong at Xia prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he sent Shangzhou commander Zhai Shousu with an army to reinforce Zhao Baozhong at Xiazhou.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，置內殿崇班、左右侍禁，改殿前承旨為三班奉職。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Inner Hall Honored Guards and Left and Right Palace Attendants were established, and Palace Front attendants were changed to Third-Rank Service Officers.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou he created Inner Hall Honored Guards and left and right palace attendants and renamed Palace Front attendants Third-Rank Service Officers.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，熒惑犯房。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Mars encroached on Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Mars trespassed on the Fang lodge.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔陝西諸州長吏設法招誘流亡，復業者計口貸粟，仍給復二年。

translations.literal: On jichou, an edict ordered the chief officials of Shaanxi prefectures to devise means to entice exiles back; those who returned to their occupations were lent grain by head count and granted two years' tax exemption.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he told Shaanxi prefects to lure refugees home, lend grain by household to those who resumed farming, and exempt them from tax for two years.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑，盡易宮殿彩繪以赭堊。

translations.literal: In the second month, on guichou, all palace frescoes were repainted in ochre whitewash.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guichou, he stripped the palaces of polychrome and repainted them in plain ochre lime.

sentences.zh: 監察御史祖吉坐知晉州日為姦贓，棄市。

translations.literal: Investigating censor Zu Ji was executed in the marketplace for taking bribes while administering Jin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censor Zu Ji, convicted of graft as Jinzhou prefect, was beheaded in the market.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，斬夔州亂卒謝榮等百餘人於市。

translations.literal: On yichou, more than a hundred mutinous soldiers of Kuizhou, including Xie Rong, were beheaded in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he had more than a hundred Kuizhou mutineers led by Xie Rong executed in public.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on xinwei, the new-moon day, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei new moon of the intercalary month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，禱雨。

translations.literal: On wuyin, he prayed for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he held rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔內外諸軍，除木槍、弓弩矢外不得蓄他兵器。

translations.literal: On dinghai, an edict ordered that throughout inner and outer armies, apart from wooden spears, bows, and crossbow bolts, no other weapons might be stored.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai he forbade every garrison except the Palace Corps to keep arms other than wooden spears, bows, and bolts.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔：京城蒲博者開封府捕之，犯者斬。

translations.literal: On jichou, an edict stated: those who gamble in the capital are to be seized by Kaifeng prefecture; offenders are to be beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he decreed that Kaifeng prefecture arrest capital gamblers and behead them on conviction.

sentences.zh: 命近臣兼差遣院流內銓。

translations.literal: He ordered close ministers concurrently to oversee the Assignment Office and the inner roster bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He put senior courtiers in joint charge of the Assignment Office and the inner personnel roster.

sentences.zh: 是月，河水溢，鄄城縣蝗，汴河決。

translations.literal: That month, the Yellow River overflowed, Yancheng county had locusts, and the Bian Canal burst its banks.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River flooded, locusts ravaged Yancheng, and the Bian Canal broke.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，幸金明池御龍舟，遂幸瓊林苑宴射。

translations.literal: In the third month, on maomao, he visited Jinming Pool and boarded the imperial dragon boat, then visited Qionglin Garden for a banquet and archery.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on maomao, he sailed the imperial dragon boat on Jinming Pool and held an archery feast in Qionglin Garden.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以歲蝗旱禱雨弗應，手詔宰相呂蒙正等：「朕將自焚，以答天譴。

translations.literal: On jisi, because locusts and drought continued and prayers for rain went unanswered, he wrote in his own hand to Chief Councilor Lü Mengzheng: "I shall burn myself to answer Heaven's reproach.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, with drought and locusts unbroken and rain prayers unanswered, he wrote Lü Mengzheng by hand: "I mean to burn myself alive to answer Heaven's wrath.

sentences.zh: 」翌日而雨，蝗盡死。

translations.literal: "The next day rain fell and the locusts all died.
translations.idiomatic: "Rain came the next day and the locusts perished.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午，罷端州貢硯。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on gengwu, Duanzhou's tribute inkstones were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengwu, he ended the Duanzhou inkstone tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以張齊賢、陳恕並參知政事，張遜兼樞密副使，溫仲舒、寇準並為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Zhang Qixian and Chen Shu were both made Associate Chief Councilors; Zhang Xun was concurrently Military Affairs Vice Commissioner; Wen Zhongshu and Kou Zhun were both made Military Affairs Vice Commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he named Zhang Qixian and Chen Shu associate chief councilors, Zhang Xun military affairs vice commissioner, and Wen Zhongshu and Kou Zhun military affairs vice commissioners.

sentences.zh: 是月，河水溢，虞鄉等七縣民饑。

translations.literal: That month, the Yellow River overflowed, and the people of seven counties including Yuxiang suffered famine.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River flooded and seven counties including Yuxiang went hungry.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥朔，詔減兩京諸州繫囚流以下一等，杖罪釋之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jihai new moon, an edict reduced by one grade all capital and circuit prisoners below exile and released those liable to the cane.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai new moon in the fifth month he cut one grade from sentences below exile in the two capitals and circuits and freed those due the cane.

sentences.zh: 庚子，置諸路提點刑獄官。

translations.literal: On gengzi, circuit judicial review commissioners were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi he created circuit commissioners for judicial review.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，左正言謝泌以敢言擢右司諫，賜金紫，錢三十萬。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on jiaxu, Left Rectifier Xie Bi was promoted to Right Remonstrance Office for bold speech, and was granted gold and purple, and three hundred thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he raised outspoken Left Rectifier Xie Bi to the Right Remonstrance Office, gave him gold-purple insignia, and thirty myriad cash.

sentences.zh: 六月甲戌，忠武軍節度使、同平章事潘美卒。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Zhongwu Army military commissioner and Associate Chief Councilor Pan Mei died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Pan Mei, Zhongwu Army commissioner and associate chief councilor, died.

sentences.zh: 命張永德為并、代都部署。

translations.literal: Zhang Yongde was made Bing and Dai commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: He named Zhang Yongde commander-in-chief of Bing and Dai.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以汴水決浚儀縣，帝親督衛士塞之。

translations.literal: On yiyou, because the Bian River burst at Junyi county, the Emperor personally supervised the guards in blocking it.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, when the Bian broke at Junyi, he himself directed the guards in closing the breach.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，禁陝西緣邊諸州闌出生口。

translations.literal: On gengyin, illicit sale of people across the Shaanxi border prefectures was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he banned the clandestine traffic in people along the Shaanxi frontier.

sentences.zh: 是月，楚丘、鄄城、淄川三縣蝗，河水、汴水溢。

translations.literal: That month, Chuqiu, Yancheng, and Zichuan counties had locusts, and the Yellow River and Bian River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: That month locusts struck Chuqiu, Yancheng, and Zichuan while the Yellow and Bian rivers flooded.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥，詔陝西緣邊諸州饑民鬻男女入近界部落者官贖之。
