translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jihai, an edict ordered that in Shaanxi border prefectures starving people who sold sons and daughters into nearby tribes were to be ransomed by the state.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the seventh month he ordered the state to redeem Shaanxi border families who had sold their children into neighboring tribes for food.

sentences.zh: 李繼遷奉表請降，以為銀州觀察使，賜國姓，改名保吉。

translations.literal: Li Jiqian presented a memorial requesting surrender; he was made Yinzhou observation commissioner, granted the imperial surname, and renamed Baoji.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiqian petitioned to submit; the emperor made him observation commissioner of Yinzhou, gave him the imperial surname, and renamed him Baoji.

sentences.zh: 是月，乾寧軍蝗，許、雄、嘉三州大水。

translations.literal: That month, Qianning Army had locusts, and Xu, Xiong, and Jia prefectures great floods.
translations.idiomatic: That month locusts hit Qianning Army and great floods Xu, Xiong, and Jia.

sentences.zh: 八月己卯，置審刑院。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jimao, the Court for Review of Punishments was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jimao, he founded the Court for Review of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 己丑，雅州言登遼山崩。

translations.literal: On jichou, Ya prefecture reported that Dengliao Mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Ya prefecture reported the collapse of Mount Dengliao.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉朔，戶部侍郎、參知政事王沔，給事中、參知政事陳恕，並罷守本官。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on dingyou, the new-moon day, Ministry of Revenue Vice Director and Associate Chief Councilor Wang Han, and Drafting Office Recipient and Associate Chief Councilor Chen Shu, were both demoted to their original posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou new moon in the ninth month Wang Han and Chen Shu were stripped of their associate chief councilor titles and returned to their former offices.

sentences.zh: 己亥，中書侍郎兼戶部尚書、平章事呂蒙正罷為吏部尚書，以右僕射李昉、參知政事張齊賢並平章事，翰林學士賈黃中、李沆並為給事中、參知政事。

translations.literal: On jihai, Secretariat Vice Director concurrent Revenue Minister and Chief Councilor Lü Mengzheng was demoted to Revenue Minister; Right Vice Director Li Fang, Associate Chief Councilor Zhang Qixian were both made Chief Councilors; Hanlin Academician Jia Huangzhong and Li Hang were both made Drafting Recipients and Associate Chief Councilors.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Lü Mengzheng left the chief councilorship for the revenue ministry while Li Fang and Zhang Qixian became chief councilors; Hanlin scholars Jia Huangzhong and Li Hang joined them as associate chief councilors.

sentences.zh: 帝飛白書「玉堂之署」四字，以賜翰林承旨蘇易簡。

translations.literal: The Emperor wrote in flying-white script the four characters "Hall of the Jade Court" and bestowed them on Hanlin Academician Su Yijian.
translations.idiomatic: He brushed the four characters "Hall of the Jade Court" in flying white and gave them to Hanlin academician Su Yijian.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，邛部川蠻來貢。

translations.literal: On renyin, Qiong tribal Man presented tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Qiong tribal chiefs sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，罷樞密使王顯為崇信軍節度使。

translations.literal: On guimao, Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Xian was demoted to Chongxin Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he demoted Military Affairs Commissioner Wang Xian to commissioner of Chongxin Army.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以張遜知樞密院事，溫仲舒、寇準同知院事。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Zhang Xun was made director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Wen Zhongshu and Kou Zhun were associate directors.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Zhang Xun became director of Military Affairs with Wen Zhongshu and Kou Zhun as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申朔，復百官次對。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the bingshen new moon, the hundred officials' turn to present memorials in audience was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen new moon in the eleventh month he restored officials' rotating audience memorials.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，罷京城內外力役土功。

translations.literal: On yisi, corvée labor and earthworks within the capital were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he ended forced labor and earthworks inside the capital walls.

sentences.zh: 己酉，幸建隆觀、相國寺祈雪。

translations.literal: On jiyou, he visited Jianlong Abbey and Xiangguo Monastery to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he prayed for snow at Jianlong Abbey and Xiangguo Monastery.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅朔，行入閤儀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the bingyin new moon, the enter-side-hall audience ceremony was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingyin new moon in the twelfth month he held the enter-side-hall audience rite.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，賜秦州童子譚孺卿本科出身。

translations.literal: On yihai, Qinzhou boy prodigy Tan Ruqing was granted jinshi of the regular curriculum.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he awarded Qinzhou child prodigy Tan Ruqing a regular-curriculum jinshi degree.

sentences.zh: 癸未，保康軍節度使劉繼元卒，追封彭城郡王。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Baokang Army military commissioner Liu Jiyuan died and was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Pengcheng commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Liu Jiyuan, commissioner of Baokang Army, died and was posthumously created Prince of Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 大雨無冰。

translations.literal: Great rain fell and there was no ice.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy rains fell and the rivers did not freeze.

sentences.zh: 是歲，女真表請伐契丹，詔不許，自是遂屬契丹。

translations.literal: That year, the Jurchen memorialized requesting permission to attack the Khitan; the edict did not assent, and from this they submitted to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Jurchen asked leave to attack the Khitan; the court refused, and thereafter they became Khitan subjects.

sentences.zh: 大名、河中，絳、濮、陝、曹、濟、同、淄、單、德、徐、晉、輝、磁、博、汝、兗、虢、汾、鄭、亳、慶、許、齊、濱、棣、沂、貝、衛、青、霸等州旱。

translations.literal: Drought struck Daming, Hezhong, Jiang, Pu, Shan, Cao, Ji, Tong, Zi, Shan, Dan, De, Xu, Jin, Hui, Ci, Bo, Ru, Yan, Guo, Fen, Zheng, Bo, Qing, Xu, Qi, Bin, Di, Yi, Bei, Wei, Qing, and Ba prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Drought spread across Daming, Hezhong, and dozens of prefectures from the Yellow River plain to the eastern seaboard.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸卯，大雨雪。

translations.literal: In year three, spring, first month, on guimao, great rain and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the first month of Chunhua year three a blizzard struck.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔常參官舉可任升朝官者。

translations.literal: On yisi, an edict ordered regular-attendance officials to recommend those fit for promotion to court office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he told regular-attendance officials to nominate candidates for promotion to the central government.

sentences.zh: 丙午，詔宰相、侍從舉可任轉運使者。

translations.literal: On bingwu, an edict ordered chief councilors and attendants to recommend those fit to serve as transport commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he required chief councilors and palace attendants to name men fit for transport commissioner posts.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the yichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou new moon in the second month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未朔，以趙普為太師，封魏國公。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the yiwei new moon, Zhao Pu was made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Duke of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei new moon in the third month Zhao Pu was created grand preceptor and Duke of Wei.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，親試禮部舉人。

translations.literal: On wuxu, he personally examined Ministry of Rites examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he personally presided over the Ministry of Rites civil examinations.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，親試諸科舉人。

translations.literal: On xinchou, he personally examined candidates of the various special curricula.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he personally examined candidates in the specialized degree tracks.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以高麗賓貢進士四十人並為秘書省秘書郎，遣還。

translations.literal: On wuwu, forty Goryeo tribute scholars who had passed the examination were all made Secretariat secretaries and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he named forty Goryeo tribute graduates secretaries in the Secretariat and sent them home.

sentences.zh: 庚申，帝幸金明池觀水戲，縱京城觀者，賜高年白金器皿。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the Emperor visited Jinming Pool to watch naval exercises, allowed capital onlookers, and bestowed white-gold vessels on the very aged.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he watched naval drills on Jinming Pool before a capital crowd and gave white-gold vessels to the eldest spectators.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁丑，詔江南、兩浙、荊湖吏民之配嶺南者還本郡禁錮。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on dingchou, an edict ordered that Jiangnan, two Zhe, and Jinghu officials and commoners banished to Lingnan were to return to their home prefectures under confinement.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingchou, he ordered exiles from Jiangnan, the two Zhes, and Jinghu sent home from Lingnan to serve confinement in their native prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸未，上作刑政、稼穡詩賜近臣。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Emperor composed poems on criminal government and the hardships of farming and bestowed them on close ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he wrote poems on justice and the farmer's toil and gave them to his inner council.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午朔，御文德殿，百官入閤。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the jiawu new moon, he held court in Wende Hall and the hundred officials entered the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon in the fifth month he held audience in Wende Hall while officials entered the side hall.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，詔御史府所斷徒罪以上獄具，令尚書丞郎、兩省給舍一人慮問。

translations.literal: On renyin, an edict ordered that for penal servitude and above decided by the Censorate, the dossier was to be sent and one Ministry Director or Secretariat-Chancellery drafting recipient was to review the case.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he required a ministry director or drafting recipient to review every Censorate case of penal servitude or worse before execution.

sentences.zh: 丁未，戶部郎中田錫、通判殿中丞郭渭坐稽留刑獄，並責州團練副使，不簽署州事。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Ministry of Revenue langzhong Tian Xi and Controller-in-Chief of the Hall Palace Assistant Guo Wei were both demoted to regiment vice-commanders for delaying criminal cases, without authority to sign prefectural business.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Tian Xi and Guo Wei, punished for letting cases languish, were demoted to regiment vice-commanders barred from signing state documents.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔太醫署良醫視京城病者，賜錢五十萬具藥，中黃門一人按視之。

translations.literal: On wushen, an edict ordered good physicians of the Imperial Medical Service to treat the sick in the capital, granted five hundred thousand cash for medicines, and one inner yellow-gate officer to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen he sent Imperial Medical Service physicians to treat the capital sick, allotted five hundred myriad cash for drugs, and assigned a palace eunuch to oversee the effort.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以旱遣使分行諸路決獄。

translations.literal: On jiyou, because of drought envoys were sent on separate routes through each circuit to adjudicate prisons.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he sent commissioners circuit by circuit to clear the prisons during the drought.

sentences.zh: 是夕，雨。

translations.literal: That evening, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell that night.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，置理檢司。

translations.literal: On xinhai, the Petition Review Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he founded the Petition Review Office.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔作秘閤。

translations.literal: On jiayin, an edict ordered construction of the Secret Archives.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he ordered work begun on the Secret Archives pavilion.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，大風晝晦，京師疫解。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on dingchou, great wind darkened the day, and the capital epidemic abated.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingchou, a gale blackened the sky and the capital plague lifted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，慮囚。

translations.literal: On wuyin, he reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 甲申，飛蝗自東北來，蔽天，經西南而去。

translations.literal: On jiashen, flying locusts came from the northeast, blotting out the sky, and passed southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen locust swarms rolled in from the northeast, darkening the heavens, and swept off toward the southwest.

sentences.zh: 是夕，大雨，蝗盡死。

translations.literal: That evening, great rain fell and the locusts all died.
translations.idiomatic: That night heavy rain fell and the locusts perished.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以殿前都虞候王昭遠為并、代兵馬都部署。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Palace Front Chief Commandant Wang Zhaoyuan was made Bing and Dai commander of armies and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he named Palace Front chief commandant Wang Zhaoyuan commander of Bing and Dai armies and horses.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，置常平倉。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Ever-Normal Granaries were established.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he established Ever-Normal Granaries.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，以秘閤成，賜近臣宴。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on wuchen, because the Secret Archives were completed, a banquet was bestowed on close ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuchen, he feasted his inner council to mark the completion of the Secret Archives.

sentences.zh: 壬申，召終南山隱士種放，不至。

translations.literal: On renshen, Zhongnan Mountain recluse Zhong Fang was summoned but did not come.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he summoned the Zhongnan hermit Zhong Fang, who declined to appear.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，闍婆國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Java sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen envoys arrived from Java with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，釋嶺南東、西路罰作荷校者。

translations.literal: On dingchou, those wearing cangue and doing penal labor in Lingnan East and West circuits were released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he freed convicts in cangue and hard labor in eastern and western Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，遣官祈晴京城諸寺觀。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen, officials were sent to pray for clear weather at capital monasteries and abbeys.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingshen, he sent officers to pray for fair skies at every capital monastery.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，幸天駟監，賜從臣馬。

translations.literal: On jiayin, he visited the Imperial Horse Stud and bestowed horses on attending ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he inspected the Imperial Horse Stud and gave horses to his attendants.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，群臣上尊號曰法天崇道明聖仁孝文武皇帝，凡五表，終不許。

translations.literal: On maomao, the hundred officials submitted a honorific title, Fa-tian Chong-dao Ming-sheng Ren-xiao Wen-wu Emperor, in five memorials; he ultimately did not assent.
translations.idiomatic: On maomao the court five times offered him the title Sagely in Aligning with Heaven, Honoring the Way, Illuminating in Sagacity, Humane and Filial, Literary and Martial Emperor—and five times he refused.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉朔，折御卿進白花鷹，放之，詔勿復獻。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on the xinyou new moon, Zhe Yuqing presented a white hawk; it was released, and an edict forbade further presentation.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou new moon in the tenth month Zhe Yuqing offered a white hawk; the emperor freed it and forbade such gifts thereafter.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，始置京朝、幕職、州縣官考課，並校三班殿最。

translations.literal: On wuyin, capital, staff, and prefectural county official performance review was first established, and the three ranks of the palace corps were also graded for merit.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he instituted performance reviews for capital, staff, and local officials and ranked the three palace corps grades by merit.

sentences.zh: 戊子，高麗、西南蕃皆遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Goryeo and the southwestern barbarians all sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi tribute envoys arrived from Goryeo and the southwest.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，大雨雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, great rain and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on dingmao, a heavy snowstorm struck.

sentences.zh: 己卯，占城國王楊陀排遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On jimao, Champa king Yang Tuopai dispatched envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao King Yang Tuopai of Champa sent tribute bearers.

sentences.zh: 是月，雄州言大火。

translations.literal: That month, Xiong prefecture reported a great fire.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiong prefecture reported a catastrophic fire.

sentences.zh: 是歲，潤州丹徒縣饑，死者三百戶。

translations.literal: That year, Runzhou Dantu county suffered famine; three hundred households died.
translations.idiomatic: That year famine in Dantu county, Runzhou, killed three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚寅朔，享太室，群臣詣齋宮拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: In year four, spring, first month, on the gengyin new moon, he offered in the Grand Temple; the hundred officials went to the fasting palace to present congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin new moon in the first month of Chunhua year four he sacrificed in the Grand Temple while officials offered felicitations from the fasting palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祀天地於圜丘，以宣祖、太祖配，大赦。

translations.literal: On xinmao, he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound, with the Progenitor and Taizu as associates; a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he offered to Heaven and Earth at the Round Mound with the dynastic founders as associates and proclaimed a grand amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大雨雪。

translations.literal: On yiwei, great rain and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei a blizzard struck.

sentences.zh: 高麗國遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo dispatched tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，藏才西族首領羅妹以良馬來獻。

translations.literal: On yisi, Zangcai Western Tribes chieftain Luomei presented fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Luomei, chieftain of the Zangcai western tribes, presented fine horses.

sentences.zh: 二月己未朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the jiwei new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon in the second month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，召賜京城高年帛，百歲者一人加賜塗金帶。

translations.literal: On renxu, he summoned and bestowed silk on the aged of the capital; for those one hundred years old, gilded belts were added.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he summoned the capital elderly and gave them silk, with gilded belts for centenarians.

sentences.zh: 是日，雨雪，大寒，再遣中使賜孤老貧窮人千錢、米炭。

translations.literal: That day, rain and snow fell and the cold was severe; palace envoys were again sent to bestow one thousand cash and fuel grain on the solitary, aged, and poor.
translations.idiomatic: That day snow and bitter cold returned, and he sent eunuchs again with a thousand cash and fuel grain for the destitute elderly.

sentences.zh: 置昭宣使。

translations.literal: Zhaoxuan envoys were established.
translations.idiomatic: He created the post of zhaoxuan envoy.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，廢沿江榷貨八務。

translations.literal: On guihai, the eight Yangzi monopoly bureaus were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he abolished the eight Yangzi river monopoly offices.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，加高麗國王王治檢校太師，靜海軍節度使黎桓封交阯郡王。

translations.literal: On yichou, Goryeo king Wang Zhi was made Acting Grand Master and Jinghai Army military commissioner Li Huan was enfeoffed as King of Jiaozhi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he named Goryeo's Wang Zhi acting grand master and enfeoffed Jinghai commissioner Li Huan as King of Jiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔以江、浙、淮、陝饑，遣使巡撫。

translations.literal: On jimao, an edict ordered that because Jiang, Zhe, Huai, and Shan suffered famine, envoys were to tour and comfort.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, with famine in Jiang, Zhe, Huai, and Shan, he sent touring commissioners to bring relief.

sentences.zh: 詔：分遣近臣巡撫諸道，有可惠民者得便宜行事，吏罷軟、苛刻者上之，詔令有未便者附傳以聞。

translations.literal: An edict stated: close ministers were to be sent on separate routes to tour each circuit; where the people could be benefited they might act at discretion; officials who were lax or harsh were to be reported upward; where edicts were inconvenient, addenda were to be sent with the report.
translations.idiomatic: He told his inner ministers to tour every circuit with discretionary power to aid the people, report slack or cruel officials, and relay any edict that needed amendment.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，置審官院、考課院。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Court for Official Review and the Performance Review Office were established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he founded the Court for Official Review and the Performance Review Office.

sentences.zh: 永康軍青城縣民王小波聚徒為寇，殺眉州彭山縣令齊元振。

translations.literal: Yongkang Army Qingcheng county commoner Wang Xiaobo gathered a band and became bandits, killing Meizhou Pengshan county magistrate Qi Yuanzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Xiaobo of Qingcheng in Yongkang Army raised a band, turned rebel, and killed Pengshan magistrate Qi Yuanzhen in Meizhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，商州大雨雪。

translations.literal: That month, Shang prefecture had great rain and snow.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shang prefecture was hit by a heavy snowstorm.

sentences.zh: 三月壬子，詔權停貢舉。

translations.literal: In the third month, on renzi, an edict temporarily suspended the civil examinations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renzi, he suspended the civil examinations for the year.

sentences.zh: 四月己卯，諸司奉行公事不得輒稱聖旨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on jimao, the various offices in carrying out public business were forbidden to invoke the sacred edict at will.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jimao, he forbade government offices from citing "imperial decree" on routine business.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，罷鹽鐵、戶部、度支等使，置三司使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on wushen, the salt-iron, revenue, and budget commissioners were abolished and a Fiscal Commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wushen, he folded the salt-iron, revenue, and budget offices into a single Fiscal Commission.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午朔，詔中丞己下皆親臨鞫獄。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the wuwu new moon, an edict ordered that from censor down all were personally to preside at trials.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuwu new moon in the sixth month he required every judge from censor down to hear cases in person.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吏部侍郎、平章事張齊賢罷為尚書左丞。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Revenue Vice Director and Chief Councilor Zhang Qixian was demoted to Left Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin chief councilor Zhang Qixian was demoted to left vice director of revenue.

sentences.zh: 壬申，宣徽北院使、知樞密院事張遜貶右領軍衛將軍，右諫議大夫、同知院事寇準罷守本官。

translations.literal: On renshen, Palace Proclamation North Court envoy and Military Affairs Director Zhang Xun was demoted to Right Army Guard general; Right Remonstrance Office Recipient and Associate Director Kou Zhun was demoted to his original post.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Zhang Xun was busted to a Right Army Guard general and Kou Zhun stripped of his military affairs deputy post.

sentences.zh: 以涪州觀察使柴禹錫為宣徽北院使、知樞密院事，樞密直學士呂端參知政事，劉昌言同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Fuzhou observation commissioner Chai Yuxi was made Palace Proclamation North Court envoy and Military Affairs Director; Hanlin Academician Lü Duan was made Associate Chief Councilor; Liu Changyan was Associate Military Affairs Director.
translations.idiomatic: He named Fuzhou commissioner Chai Yuxi military affairs director, Hanlin scholar Lü Duan associate chief councilor, and Liu Changyan associate military affairs director.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，初復給事中封駁。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the drafting recipient's power of seal-and-return was first restored.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he restored drafting recipients' power to seal and return memorials.

sentences.zh: 七月丁酉，大雨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on dingyou, great rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on dingyou, torrential rains fell.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，復沿江務，置諸路茶鹽制置使。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Yangzi river offices were restored and circuit tea-and-salt regulatory commissioners were established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he reopened the Yangzi monopoly bureaus and appointed circuit tea-and-salt commissioners.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the bingchen new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon in the eighth month the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以向敏中、張詠始同知銀台、通進司，視章奏案牘以稽出入。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Xiang Minzhong and Zhang Yong were first made associate directors of the Silver Terrace and Communication Office, examining memorial dossiers to check passage in and out.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Xiang Minzhong and Zhang Yong became the first associate directors of the Silver Terrace office, auditing every memorial that entered or left the palace.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，詔：諸雜除禁錮人，州縣有闕得次補以責効，能自新勤幹者具聞再敘。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen, an edict stated: for miscellaneous persons under confinement, where prefectural and county posts were vacant they might be appointed in order to test effectiveness; those who reformed themselves through diligence were to be reported for reinstatement.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen he allowed confined offenders to fill vacant local posts on probation and recommended the diligent for restoration to rank.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以給事中封駁隸銀台、通進司。

translations.literal: On yisi, the drafting recipient's seal-and-return authority was placed under the Silver Terrace and Communication Office.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he subordinated drafting recipients' seal-and-return power to the Silver Terrace office.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命侍從舉任才堪五千戶以上縣令者二人。

translations.literal: On bingwu, attendants were ordered to recommend two men fit to serve as magistrates of counties of five thousand households and above.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he told palace attendants each to nominate two men fit for magistracies of five thousand households or more.

sentences.zh: 自七月雨，至是不止。

translations.literal: From the seventh month it had rained without cease until now.
translations.idiomatic: Rain had fallen without stop since the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 是月，河水溢，壞澶州；

translations.literal: That month, the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed Cao prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River flooded and wrecked Cao prefecture;

sentences.zh: 江溢，陷涪州。

translations.literal: the Yangzi overflowed and submerged Fu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: the Yangzi burst its banks and drowned Fu prefecture.

sentences.zh: 詔溺死者給斂具，澶人千錢，涪人鐵錢三千，仍發廩以振。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that for those drowned, burial goods were supplied—one thousand cash for Cao victims and three thousand iron cash for Fu victims—and granaries were opened for relief.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered burial stipends for the drowned—one thousand cash in Cao, three thousand iron cash in Fu—and opened the granaries for relief.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，罷諸路提點刑獄司。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on renxu, circuit judicial review offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renxu, he abolished the circuit judicial review commissions.

sentences.zh: 庚午，始分天下州縣為十道，兩京為左右計，各署判官領之，置三司使二員。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the empire's prefectures and counties were first divided into ten circuits; the two capitals were left and right accounting circuits, each with a supervising judge; two Fiscal Commissioners were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he carved the empire into ten fiscal circuits with the two capitals as left and right accounting zones, each under a supervising judge, and appointed two fiscal commissioners.

sentences.zh: 辛未，右僕射、平章事李昉，給事中、參知政事賈黃中、李沆，左諫議大夫、同知樞密院事溫仲舒並罷守本官。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Right Vice Director and Chief Councilor Li Fang, Drafting Recipients and Associate Chief Councilors Jia Huangzhong and Li Hang, and Left Remonstrance Office Recipient and Associate Military Affairs Director Wen Zhongshu were all demoted to their original posts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Li Fang, Jia Huangzhong, Li Hang, and Wen Zhongshu were all stripped of their chief councilor and military affairs posts.

sentences.zh: 以吏部尚書呂蒙正平章事，翰林學士蘇易簡為給事中、參知政事；

translations.literal: Revenue Minister Lü Mengzheng was made Chief Councilor; Hanlin Academician Su Yijian was made Drafting Recipient and Associate Chief Councilor;
translations.idiomatic: Lü Mengzheng returned as chief councilor and Hanlin scholar Su Yijian joined him as associate chief councilor;

sentences.zh: 樞密都承旨趙鎔為宣徽北院使，樞密直學士向敏中為右諫議大夫，並同知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Military Affairs Chief Administrator Zhao Rong was made Palace Proclamation North Court envoy; Military Affairs Academician Xiang Minzhong was made Right Remonstrance Office Recipient; both were Associate Military Affairs Directors.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Rong became north-court envoy and Xiang Minzhong right remonstrance recipient, both as associate military affairs directors.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以右諫議大夫趙昌言為給事中、參知政事。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Right Remonstrance Office Recipient Zhao Changyan was made Drafting Recipient and Associate Chief Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Zhao Changyan was promoted to drafting recipient and associate chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，遣使按行畿縣，民田被水者蠲其租。

translations.literal: On xinsi, envoys were sent to inspect the capital counties; rent was remitted on civilian fields inundated.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he sent commissioners to survey the capital counties and remit rent on flooded farmland.

sentences.zh: 是月，河決澶州，西北流入御河。

translations.literal: That month, the river burst at Cao prefecture and flowed northwest into the Imperial Canal.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Yellow River broke at Cao and poured northwest into the Imperial Canal.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛卯，幸水磑觀魚。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on xinmao, he visited the water mill to view fish.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinmao, he visited the water mill to watch the fish.

sentences.zh: 己酉，置三司總計度使。

translations.literal: On jiyou, the Fiscal Commissioner Chief Accountant was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he created the post of chief accountant to the Fiscal Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，萬安州獻六眸龜。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingsi, Wan'an prefecture presented a six-eyed tortoise.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingsi, Wan'an prefecture offered a six-eyed tortoise.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，還隴西州所獻白鷹。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the white hawk presented by Longxi prefecture was returned.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he sent back the white hawk Longxi had offered.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，大雨雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, great rain and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinchou, a blizzard struck.

sentences.zh: 戊申，西川都巡檢使張玘與王小波戰江原縣，死之。

translations.literal: On wushen, Sichuan circuit inspector-general Zhang Qi fought Wang Xiaobo at Jiangyuan county and died.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Sichuan inspector Zhang Qi met Wang Xiaobo at Jiangyuan and was killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 小波中流矢死，眾推其黨李順為帥。

translations.literal: Xiaobo was struck by a stray arrow and died; the band enthroned his follower Li Shun as commander.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaobo took a stray arrow and died, and the rebels raised his lieutenant Li Shun as their leader.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月甲寅朔，不受朝，群臣詣閤拜表稱賀。

translations.literal: In year five, spring, first month, on the jiayin new moon, he did not hold audience; the hundred officials went to the side hall to present congratulatory memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon in the first month of Chunhua year five he withheld court audience while officials offered New Year felicitations at the side hall.

sentences.zh: 戊午，李順陷漢州，已未，陷彭州。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Li Shun took Han prefecture; on jiwei, he took Peng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Li Shun seized Hanzhou; the next day, on jiwei, he took Pengzhou.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，慮囚，流罪以下釋之。

translations.literal: On yichou, he reviewed prisoners; those below exile were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he held a prison review and freed everyone below exile.

sentences.zh: 己巳，李順陷成都，知府郭載奔梓州，順入據之，賊兵四出攻劫州縣。

translations.literal: On jisi, Li Shun took Chengdu; prefect Guo Zai fled to Zizhou, and Shun entered and occupied it; rebel troops spread out to attack and plunder prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Li Shun stormed Chengdu; prefect Guo Zai fled to Zizhou while Shun seized the city and his bands fanned out to raid the province.

sentences.zh: 遣使振宋、亳、陳、潁州饑民，別遣決諸路刑獄，應因饑劫藏粟，誅為首者，餘減死。

translations.literal: Envoys were sent to relieve the famine-stricken of Song, Bo, Chen, and Ying prefectures; others were separately sent to decide criminal cases in each circuit; for those who robbed granaries from famine, the ringleaders were executed and the rest had death reduced.
translations.idiomatic: He sent grain to famine victims in Song, Bo, Chen, and Ying, cleared criminal dockets circuit by circuit, executed famine-riot ringleaders, and commuted their followers' death sentences.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使李繼隆為河西行營都部署，討李繼遷。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Palace Horse Army Commander-in-Chief Li Jilong was made commander-in-chief of the Hexi campaign headquarters to attack Li Jiqian.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou he named Palace Horse Army commander Li Jilong to lead the Hexi headquarters against Li Jiqian.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命昭宣使王繼恩為兩川招安使，討李順。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Zhaoxuan envoy Wang Jien was made pacification commissioner of the two Sichuan circuits to attack Li Shun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he commissioned zhaoxuan envoy Wang Jien pacification commissioner of the two Sichuan circuits to crush Li Shun.

sentences.zh: 詔諸州能出粟貸饑民者賜爵。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that prefectures able to lend grain to famine victims were granted noble rank.
translations.idiomatic: He promised ennoblement to any prefecture that could lend grain to the starving.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔除兩京諸州淳化三年逋負。

translations.literal: On xinsi, an edict remitted Chunhua year three arrears in the two capitals and all prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he canceled Chunhua year three tax arrears in the capitals and every prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，李順分攻劍州，都監西京作坊副使上官正、成都監軍供奉官宿翰合擊大破之，斬馘殆盡。

translations.literal: In the second month, on yiwei, Li Shun divided his forces to attack Jian prefecture; metropolitan controller of the Western Capital workshop deputy Shangguan Zheng and Chengdu supervisory commissioner Su Han jointly attacked and utterly defeated them, beheading nearly all.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yiwei, Li Shun struck at Jianzhou; Shangguan Zheng and the Chengdu commissioner Su Han routed his columns and slaughtered nearly every man.

sentences.zh: 丙午，幸南御莊觀稼。

translations.literal: On bingwu, he visited the Southern Imperial Estate to view the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu he toured the Southern Imperial Estate to inspect the harvest.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以益王元傑為淮南、鎮江等軍節度使，徙封吳王。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Prince Yuanjie of Yi was made Huainan and Zhenjiang and other armies military commissioner and transferred to the title Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Prince Yuanjie of Yi became Huainan and Zhenjiang commissioner and was retitled Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔除劍南東西川、峽路諸州主吏民卒淳化五年以前逋負。

translations.literal: On xinhai, an edict remitted arrears before Chunhua year five owed by chief clerks, commoners, and soldiers of the eastern and western Sichuan and Gorges circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he canceled pre–Chunhua year five tax debts owed by clerks, commoners, and soldiers in eastern and western Sichuan and the Gorges.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，趙保忠為趙保吉所襲，奔還夏州，指揮使趙光嗣執之以獻，李繼隆帥師入夏州。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yihai, Zhao Baozhong was attacked by Zhao Baoji, fled back to Xia prefecture, and was seized and presented by commander Zhao Guangsi; Li Jilong led troops into Xia prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yihai, Zhao Baoji drove Zhao Baozhong back to Xiazhou, where commander Zhao Guangsi seized him for the court; Li Jilong then marched into Xiazhou.

sentences.zh: 交阯郡王黎桓遣使來貢。

translations.literal: King of Jiaozhi commandery Li Huan sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Li Huan, king of Jiaozhi, sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬午朔，詔除天下主吏逋負。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the renwu new moon, an edict remitted arrears owed by chief clerks throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon in the fourth month he canceled tax arrears owed by chief clerks empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 甲申，削趙保吉所賜姓名。

translations.literal: On jiashen, the surname and personal name bestowed on Zhao Baoji were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he revoked the imperial surname and name he had granted Zhao Baoji.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，置起居院，初復起居注。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Daily Activities Office was established and the Daily Activities record was first restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he founded the Daily Activities Office and restored the court diary.

sentences.zh: 以國子學復為國子監。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Education was again made the Directorate of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He restored the Directorate of Education as the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，慮囚。

translations.literal: On xinmao, he reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 大食國王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The king of Dashi sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Abbasid caliph sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，赦諸州，除十惡、故劫殺、官吏犯正贓外，降死罪以下囚。

translations.literal: On wuxu, amnesty was proclaimed in all prefectures; apart from the ten abominations, prior robbery and murder, and officials' capital corruption, prisoners with death sentences and below were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he proclaimed amnesty in every prefecture, commuting all but the ten capital crimes, old robbery-murder, and official corruption.

sentences.zh: 己亥，王繼恩帥師過綿州，賊潰走，追殺及溺死者甚眾。

translations.literal: On jihai, Wang Jien led troops past Mian prefecture; the bandits fled in rout, and pursuit killing and drowning claimed very many.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Wang Jien marched through Mianzhou; the rebels broke and ran, and pursuit left countless dead in the water and on the field.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復綿州。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Mian prefecture was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Mianzhou was retaken.

sentences.zh: 內殿崇班曹習破賊于老溪，復閬州。

translations.literal: Inner Hall Honored Guard Cao Xi defeated the bandits at Laoxi and recovered Lang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Inner Hall Honored Guard Cao Xi routed the rebels at Laoxi and restored Langzhou.

sentences.zh: 綿州巡檢使胡正遠帥兵進擊，復巴州。

translations.literal: Mian prefecture inspector Hu Zhengyuan led troops in attack and recovered Ba prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mianzhou inspector Hu Zhengyuan advanced and retook Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，西川行營擊賊于研口砦，破之，復劍州。

translations.literal: On renyin, the Xichuan field headquarters attacked the rebels at Yankou Stockade, defeated them, and recovered Jian prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Sichuan expedition struck the rebels at Yankou Stockade, routed them, and took Jian prefecture back.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大雨。

translations.literal: On guimao, heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: Guimao brought torrential rain.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，西川行營破賊十萬眾，斬首三萬級，復成都，獲賊李順。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on dingsi, the Xichuan field headquarters broke one hundred thousand rebels, beheaded thirty thousand, recovered Chengdu, and captured the rebel Li Shun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the fifth month the Sichuan army shattered a rebel host of one hundred thousand, took thirty thousand heads, retook Chengdu, and seized Li Shun.

sentences.zh: 其黨張餘復攻陷嘉、戎、瀘、渝，涪、忠、萬、開八州，開州監軍秦傳序死之。

translations.literal: His partisan Zhang Yu again attacked and seized Jia, Rong, Lu, Yu, Fu, Zhong, Wan, and Kai—the eight prefectures—and Kai prefecture supervisory commissioner Qin Chuanxu died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shun's lieutenant Zhang Yu swept back through eight prefectures—Jia, Rong, Lu, Yu, Fu, Zhong, Wan, and Kai—and killed Kai's supervisory commissioner Qin Chuanxu when he fell defending the city.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，河西行營送趙保忠至闕下，釋其罪，授右千牛衛上將軍，封宥罪侯。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Hexi field headquarters sent Zhao Baozhong to the capital; his crimes were pardoned, he was made General-in-Chief of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard, and enfeoffed as Marquis Pardoned-of-Crime.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the Hexi command delivered Zhao Baozhong to court; the emperor forgave his treason, named him a general of the Right Thousand-Ox Guard, and created him Marquis Pardoned-of-Crime.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以知梓州張雍、都巡檢使盧斌嘗堅守却賊，斌進擊解閬州圍，遂平蓬州，雍加給事中，斌領成州刺史。

translations.literal: On jisi, because Zhang Yong, who knew Zizhou, and chief patrol inspector Lu Bin had once held firm and repelled the rebels, and Bin had advanced, attacked, and lifted the siege of Lang prefecture and then pacified Peng prefecture, Yong was promoted to Supervising Censor and Bin was made prefect of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Zhang Yong of Zizhou and chief patrol inspector Lu Bin were rewarded for their defense: Bin, who had broken the siege of Lang and cleared Peng, became prefect of Cheng; Yong received the rank of supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 以少府監雷有終為諫議大夫、知成都府。

translations.literal: Supervisor of the Palace Workshops Lei Youzhong was made Remonstrance Official and given charge of Chengdu prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Lei Youzhong, supervisor of the palace workshops, was named remonstrance official and acting prefect of Chengdu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，賊攻夔州，峽路都大巡檢白繼贇、夔州巡檢使解守顒大敗其眾於西津口，斬首二萬級，獲舟千餘艘。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the rebels attacked Kuizhou; Grand Patrol Inspector of the Gorges Route Bai Jiyun and Kuizhou patrol inspector Xie Shouyong greatly defeated their force at Xijin Ford, beheaded twenty thousand, and captured more than a thousand boats.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu rebels assailed Kuizhou; Bai Jiyun, grand inspector of the gorges route, and Kuizhou's Xie Shouyong crushed them at Xijin Ford with twenty thousand heads taken and over a thousand boats seized.

sentences.zh: 辛未，降成都府為益州。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Chengdu prefecture was reduced to Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the court demoted Chengdu prefecture back to Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 壬申，右僕射李昉以司空致仕。

translations.literal: On renshen, Right Vice Director Li Fang retired as Grand Master of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Right Vice Director Li Fang left office with the honorary title Grand Master of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔利州、興元府、洋州、西縣民並給復一年。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, an edict granted the people of Lizhou, Xingyuan prefecture, Yang prefecture, and Xi county a full year's remission of corvée and rent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the emperor remitted a year of taxes and labor service for Lizhou, Xingyuan, Yangzhou, and Xi county.

sentences.zh: 丙子，磔李順黨八人于鳳翔市。

translations.literal: On bingzi, eight of Li Shun's partisans were dismembered in the Fengxiang market.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi eight of Li Shun's followers were executed by dismemberment in Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，初伏，帝親書綾扇賜近臣。

translations.literal: On gengchen, at the first dog-days heat, the Emperor personally wrote silk fans and bestowed them on close ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, as the first dog-days began, Taizong inscribed fans of figured silk for his inner circle.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，詔赦李順脅從詿誤。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinmao, an edict pardoned those whom Li Shun had coerced or misled into error.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the sixth month he proclaimed amnesty for everyone Li Shun had dragooned or duped.

sentences.zh: 是月，都城大疫，分遣醫官煮藥給病者。

translations.literal: That month a great pestilence struck the capital; medical officers were dispatched in divisions to boil medicine for the sick.
translations.idiomatic: That month plague swept the capital, and the court sent physicians out in teams to brew medicine for the afflicted.

sentences.zh: 賊攻施州，指揮使黃希遜擊走之。

translations.literal: The rebels attacked Shi prefecture; commander Huang Xisun drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels struck Shi prefecture, but commander Huang Xisun beat them back.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，峽路行營破賊于廣安軍，又破賊張罕二萬眾于嘉陵江口，又破于合州西方溪，俘斬甚眾。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Gorges Route field headquarters defeated the rebels at Guang'an Army, again broke Zhang Han's twenty thousand at Jialing River mouth, and again defeated them at Western Stream in He prefecture, capturing and beheading a great many.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the gorges expedition won at Guang'an Army, shattered Zhang Han's twenty thousand at the mouth of the Jialing, and routed them again at Western Stream in He prefecture, taking heads by the thousands.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以侍衛步軍都指揮使高瓊為鎮州都部署。

translations.literal: On wushen, Palace Front commander Gao Qiong was made overall deployment commander of Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Gao Qiong, commander of the palace foot guards, became supreme commander at Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 賊攻陵州，知州張旦擊破之。

translations.literal: The rebels attacked Ling prefecture; prefect Zhang Dan defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels besieged Ling prefecture; prefect Zhang Dan threw them back.

sentences.zh: 高麗遣使，以契丹來侵乞師。

translations.literal: Goryeo sent envoys begging troops because the Khitan had invaded.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo dispatched envoys pleading for soldiers against a Khitan invasion.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥朔，賊攻眉州，知州李簡等堅守逾月，賊引去。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinhai the new moon, the rebels attacked Mei prefecture; prefect Li Jian and others held firm for more than a month, and the rebels withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai new moon in the seventh month rebels invested Mei prefecture; Li Jian and his garrison held for over a month until the enemy withdrew.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，置江、淮、兩浙發運使。

translations.literal: On guihai, transport commissioners for the Yangzi, Huai, and Two Zhes were established.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he created transport commissioners for the Yangzi, Huai, and Two Zhe circuits.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，除兩浙諸州民錢俶日逋負。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the people of the Two Zhe prefectures were cleared of daily arrears owed to Qian Chu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin he canceled the daily debts the Two Zhes still owed to Qian Chu.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，置威塞軍。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Weisai Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he founded Weisai Army.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，李繼遷遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On yihai, Li Jiqian sent envoys bearing tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Li Jiqian presented tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 八月甲申，詔有司講求大射儀注。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jiashen, an edict ordered the offices to study and fix the ritual regulations for the great archery ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the eighth month he commanded the ministries to compile the rites for the great archery ceremony.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以內班為黃門。

translations.literal: On guisi, inner attendants were made Yellow Gate officials.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi palace inner attendants were reclassified as Yellow Gate officers.

sentences.zh: 甲午，置宣政使，以宦者昭宣使王繼恩為之。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the post of Director of Court Administration was created, and eunuch Commissioner of Proclamation Wang Jien was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he instituted the office of Director of Court Administration and gave it to the eunuch Wang Jien.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔釋劍南、峽路諸州亡命。

translations.literal: On yiwei, an edict pardoned fugitives in the Sword South and Gorges Route prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he proclaimed amnesty for outlaws throughout Sword South and the gorges routes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以通遠軍復為環州，置清遠軍。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Tongyuan Army was restored as Huan prefecture and Qingyuan Army was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Tongyuan Army was re-established as Huan prefecture and Qingyuan Army was founded.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大雨。

translations.literal: On gengzi, heavy rain.
translations.idiomatic: Gengzi brought heavy rain again.

sentences.zh: 貝州言驍捷卒劫庫兵為亂，推都虞候趙咸雍為帥，轉運使王嗣宗率屯兵擊敗之，擒咸雍，磔於市。

translations.literal: Bei prefecture reported that swift-as-eagles troops had raided the armory for weapons and risen in revolt, making Chief Commandant Zhao Xianyong their leader; transport commissioner Wang Sizong led garrison troops, defeated them, captured Xianyong, and dismembered him in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Beizhou reported that elite "swift-eagle" troops had looted the armory and mutinied under Chief Commandant Zhao Xianyong; transport commissioner Wang Sizong crushed the rising, seized Xianyong, and had him torn apart in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔遣知益州張詠赴部，得便宜從事。

translations.literal: On xinchou, an edict dispatched Zhang Yong, who knew Yizhou, to the capital with authority to act as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he recalled Zhang Yong from Yizhou with discretionary powers to handle affairs on the road.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以參知政事趙昌言為西川、峽路招安馬步軍都部署，尋詔昌言駐鳳翔，遣內侍押班衛紹欽往行營指揮軍事。

translations.literal: On guimao, Participant in Governance Zhao Changyan was made overall deployment commander of pacification horse-and-foot forces for Xichuan and the Gorges Route; soon an edict ordered Changyan to remain at Fengxiang and dispatched inner attendant Director of Escort Wei Shaoqin to the field headquarters to direct military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Vice Councilor Zhao Changyan was named supreme pacification commander for Sichuan and the gorges; shortly afterward Changyan was ordered to stay at Fengxiang while the eunuch Wei Shaoqin went forward to take command in the field.

sentences.zh: 峽路行營破賊帥張餘，復雲安軍。

translations.literal: The Gorges Route field headquarters defeated the rebel leader Zhang Yu and recovered Yun'an Army.
translations.idiomatic: The gorges expedition killed the rebel chief Zhang Yu and retook Yun'an Army.

sentences.zh: 李繼遷使其弟奉表待罪。

translations.literal: Li Jiqian had his younger brother submit a memorial awaiting punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiqian sent his brother to court with a memorial submitting to judgment.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌朔，戶部尚書辛仲甫以太子少保致仕。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengxu the new moon, Minister of Revenue Xin Zhongfu retired as Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon in the ninth month Revenue Minister Xin Zhongfu retired as junior mentor of the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，賜三司錢百萬，募能言司事之利便者，量事賞之，盡則再給以備賞。

translations.literal: On jiayin, three million cash from the Salt and Iron Commission was granted to recruit anyone able to speak of profitable reforms in its affairs; rewards were meted according to the proposal, and when the fund was exhausted it was replenished for further awards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin he set aside three million cash from the Salt and Iron Bureau to reward anyone with practical proposals for its operations, paying out by merit and refilling the purse when it ran dry.

sentences.zh: 己未，罷諸州榷酤。

translations.literal: On jiwei, government monopoly on wine in all prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei he ended the state wine monopoly in every prefecture.

sentences.zh: 改黃門院為內侍省，以黃門班院為內侍省內侍班院，入內黃門班院為內侍省入內侍班院。

translations.literal: The Yellow Gate Directorate was changed to the Palace Domestic Service; the Yellow Gate Shift Directorate became the Inner Shift Directorate of the Palace Domestic Service, and the Inner-Entry Yellow Gate Shift Directorate became the Inner-Entry Shift Directorate of the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: He reorganized the eunuch bureaucracy: the Yellow Gate Directorate became the Palace Domestic Service, with separate inner and outer shift bureaus under the new name.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，遣使分行宋、亳、陳、潁、泗、壽、鄧、蔡等州按行民田，被水及種蒔不及者並蠲其租。

translations.literal: On xinyou, envoys were dispatched separately to tour the fields of Song, Bo, Chen, Ying, Si, Shou, Deng, Cai, and other prefectures; wherever land had been flooded or planting had failed, rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he sent commissioners through Song, Bo, Chen, Ying, Si, Shou, Deng, Cai, and neighboring prefectures to cancel tax on fields drowned by flood or too late for planting.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以襄王元侃為開封尹，改封壽王。

translations.literal: On renshen, Prince of Xiang Yuan Kan was made Metropolitan Governor of Kaifeng and his enfeoffment was changed to Prince of Shou.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Prince Yuan Kan of Xiang became metropolitan governor of Kaifeng and was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Shou.

sentences.zh: 大赦，除十惡、故謀劫鬬殺、官吏犯正贓外，諸官先犯贓罪配隸禁錮者放還。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed; except for the ten abominations, premeditated robbery, brawling homicide, and officials' capital corruption, officials who had earlier been sentenced for corruption and banished under close confinement were released and restored.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a grand amnesty: aside from the ten capital crimes, armed robbery, brawling murder, and flagrant official corruption, disgraced officials under lifetime banishment for bribery were freed and allowed home.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以左諫議大夫寇準參知政事。

translations.literal: On yihai, Left Remonstrance Official Kou Zhun was made Participant in Governance.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Left Remonstrator Kou Zhun joined the council as vice grand councilor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以蜀部漸平，下詔罪己。

translations.literal: On dingchou, because the Shu region was gradually pacified, an edict blamed the emperor himself.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, with Sichuan nearly quiet, he issued an edict of self-reproach.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，西川行營言衛紹欽破賊于學射山，別將楊瓊復蜀州，曹習等又破賊于安國鎮，誅其帥馬太保。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Xichuan field headquarters reported that Wei Shaoqin had defeated rebels at Study-Archery Mountain, sub-commander Yang Qiong had recovered Shu prefecture, and Cao Xi and others had again broken the rebels at Anguo Town and executed their leader Ma the Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Sichuan command reported Wei Shaoqin's victory at Study-Archery Mountain, Yang Qiong's recapture of Shu prefecture, and Cao Xi's rout of the rebels at Anguo Town, where their chieftain Ma the Grand Guardian was put to death.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，詔釋殿前司逃軍親屬之禁錮者。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on gengchen, an edict released from close confinement the kin of deserters from the Palace Front Office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the tenth month he freed the families of deserters from the palace guard, who had been held under collective punishment.

sentences.zh: 西川行營指揮使張嶙殺其將王文壽以叛，遣使招撫其眾，遂共斬嶙首以降。

translations.literal: Xichuan field headquarters commander Zhang Lin killed his officer Wang Wenshou on a charge of rebellion, sent envoys to win over the troops, and they together beheaded Lin's head and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan commander Zhang Lin murdered his subordinate Wang Wenshou for treason and tried to rally the army; instead his own men slew him and submitted.

sentences.zh: 乙未，楊瓊等復邛州。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Yang Qiong and others recovered Qiong prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Yang Qiong and his column retook Qiong prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，改青州平盧軍為鎮海軍，杭州鎮海軍為寧海軍。

translations.literal: On yisi, Pinglu Army of Qing prefecture was changed to Zhenhai Army, and Zhenhai Army of Hang prefecture was changed to Ninghai Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Qingzhou's Pinglu Army was renamed Zhenhai Army, and Hangzhou's Zhenhai Army was renamed Ninghai Army.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚戌，遣使諭李繼遷，賜以器幣、茶藥、衣服。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengxu, envoys were sent to instruct Li Jiqian and bestow vessels, tea, medicine, and clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the eleventh month he dispatched envoys to Li Jiqian with gifts of vessels, tea, medicine, and robes.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，賜近臣飛白書。

translations.literal: On bingchen, flying-white calligraphy was bestowed on close ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he presented his flying-white script to the inner circle.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔：江南西路及荊湖南北路、嶺南溪洞接連及蕃商、外國使誘子女出境者捕之。

translations.literal: On gengshen, an edict: in Jiangnan West Circuit and Jinghu South and North, and in the Lingnan stream grottoes where they adjoin one another, as well as among tribal merchants and foreign envoys—whoever entices children across the border is to be arrested.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen he decreed that anyone in Jiangnan West, the two Jinghu circuits, or the Lingnan frontier who lured children away—whether local broker, tribal trader, or foreign envoy—was to be seized.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，賊攻眉州，崇儀使宿翰等擊敗之，斬其偽中書令吳蘊。

translations.literal: On guihai, the rebels attacked Mei prefecture; Honored Ritualist Su Han and others defeated them and beheaded their false Secretariat Director Wu Yun.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai rebels again struck Mei prefecture; Su Han and his officers routed them and took the head of the pretender's Secretariat Director Wu Yun.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸國子監，賜直講孫奭緋魚，因幸武成王廟，復幸國子監，令奭講尚書，賜以束帛。

translations.literal: On bingyin, the Emperor visited the Directorate of Education, bestowed crimson fish tokens on lecturer Sun Shi, then visited the temple of King Wu of Zhou, returned to the Directorate, ordered Shi to lecture on the Documents, and granted him silks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Taizong went to the Imperial Academy, gave lecturer Sun Shi the crimson fish insignia of rank, paid homage at the temple of King Wu, returned for Sun's lecture on the Documents, and rewarded him with silks.

sentences.zh: 大寒，賜禁衛諸軍緡錢有差。

translations.literal: In great cold, the Palace Front and other guards were given cash stipends in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: During the deep cold he distributed graded cash bonuses to the palace guards.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅朔，日當食，雲陰不見。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuyin the new moon, the sun should have been eclipsed, but clouds hid it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon in the twelfth month an eclipse was due, but cloud cover concealed it.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，命樞密直學士張鑑、西京作坊副使馮守規安撫西川。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Academician-Attendant of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhang Jian and Western Capital workshop vice-director Feng Shougui were ordered to pacify Xichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi he sent Military Affairs academician Zhang Jian and Western Capital workshop vice-director Feng Shougui to pacify Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，命諸王畋近郊。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the princes were ordered to hunt in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he sent the imperial princes hunting in the outskirts.

sentences.zh: 弛忠、靖二州刑徒。

translations.literal: Penal convicts in Zhong and Jing prefectures were released.
translations.idiomatic: He freed penal laborers in Zhong and Jing prefectures.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宿翰等引兵趨嘉州，偽知州王文操以城降。

translations.literal: On gengyin, Su Han and others led troops toward Jia prefecture, and the false prefect Wang Wencao surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Su Han marched on Jia prefecture, and the rebel prefect Wang Wencao opened the gates.

sentences.zh: 乙未，秘書丞張樞坐知榮州降賊，棄市。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Secretariat aide Zhang Shu was executed in the market for knowing Rong prefecture yet submitting to the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Secretariat aide Zhang Shu was beheaded for yielding Rong prefecture to the rebels.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以三司兩京、十道復歸三部，各置使一員，每部置判官、推官、都監，分勾院為三。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the Two Capitals and Ten Circuits of the Salt and Iron Commission were restored to three departments, each with one commissioner; each department was given an adjudicator, investigating official, and chief controller, and the unified audit office was split into three.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he re-divided the Salt and Iron Bureau into three departments for the two capitals and ten circuits, each with its own commissioner, staff, and separate audit office.

sentences.zh: 至道元年正月戊申朔，改元，赦京畿繫囚，流罪以下遞降一等，杖罪釋之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhidao, first month, on wushen the new moon, the reign title was changed; capital prisoners were pardoned, exile and below were reduced one grade, and flogging offenses were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen new moon in the first month of Zhidao 1 he changed the reign era, amnestied metropolitan prisoners, commuted exile by one degree, and freed those sentenced to beating.

sentences.zh: 蠲諸州逋租，蠲陝西諸州去年秋稅之半。

translations.literal: Overdue rent in all prefectures was remitted, and half of last year's autumn tax in Shaanxi prefectures was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: He canceled back taxes nationwide and halved the previous autumn levy across Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔作上清宮成。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict announced completion of the Shangqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he proclaimed the Shangqing Palace finished.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，涼州吐蕃當尊以良馬來獻。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Dangzun of the Liangzhou Tibetans presented fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Tibetan leader Dangzun of Liangzhou brought tribute horses.

sentences.zh: 戊午，占城國王楊陀排遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On wuwu, King Yang Tuopai of Champa sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu King Yang Tuopai of Champa dispatched tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，上御乾元門觀燈。

translations.literal: On xinyou, the Emperor mounted the Qianyuan Gate to view the lanterns.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Taizong took the Qianyuan Gate to watch the lantern festival.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，契丹大將韓德威誘党項勒浪、嵬族自振武犯邊，永安節度使折御卿邀擊，敗之于子河汊，勒浪等乘亂反擊德威，遂殺其將突厥大尉、司徒、舍利等，獲吐渾首領一人，德威僅以身免。

translations.literal: On guihai, Khitan general Han Dewei induced the Tangut Leilang and Wei tribes from Zhenwu to raid the border; Yong'an military commissioner Zhe Yuqing intercepted them and defeated them at Zihe Ford; Leilang and others turned in the confusion and counterattacked Dewei, killing his generals the Turkic Grand Commandant, the Steward, and the Sheli, capturing one Tuyuhun chieftain, and Dewei barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Khitan general Han Dewei led Tangut Leilang and Wei clans from Zhenwu against the frontier; Zhe Yuqing of Yong'an ambushed him at Zihe Ford. The allies then turned on Dewei in the melée, killing his Turkic commanders and a Sheli prince, taking a Tuyuhun chief, while Dewei fled with only his life.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以翰林學士錢若水為右諫議大夫、同知樞密院事，樞密副使劉昌言罷為給事中。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Hanlin academician Qian Ruoshui was made Right Remonstrance Official and Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs; Vice Director Liu Changyan was dismissed to Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Hanlin academician Qian Ruoshui became right remonstrator and associate director of military affairs, while Vice Director Liu Changyan was demoted to supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 以宣祖舊第作洞真宮成。

translations.literal: The Founding Ancestor's former residence was completed as Dongzhen Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu's childhood home was finished as Dongzhen Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，李繼遷遣使以良馬、橐駝來貢。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Li Jiqian sent envoys presenting fine horses and camels.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Li Jiqian sent tribute horses and Bactrian camels.

sentences.zh: 二月甲申，命宰相禱雨。

translations.literal: In the second month, on jiashen, the chief ministers were ordered to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the second month he ordered the chief ministers to conduct rain prayers.

sentences.zh: 令川峽諸州瘞暴骸。

translations.literal: The Sichuan and Gorges prefectures were ordered to bury exposed corpses.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded the Sichuan and gorges prefectures to inter unburied dead.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以旱慮囚，減流罪以下。

translations.literal: On wuxu, because of drought prisoners were reviewed and exile and below were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, with drought gripping the realm, he reviewed the prisons and commuted sentences below exile.

sentences.zh: 丙午，雨。

translations.literal: On bingwu, rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu rain finally fell.

sentences.zh: 嘉州函賊帥張餘首送西川行營，餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: Jia prefecture sent the rebel leader Zhang Yu's head in a box to the Xichuan field headquarters, and the remainder of his partisans were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Jia prefecture delivered Zhang Yu's head to the Sichuan command, and the last of his followers were extinguished.

sentences.zh: 蠲襄、唐、均、汝、隨、鄧、歸、峽等州去年逋租。

translations.literal: Overdue rent in Xiang, Tang, Jun, Ru, Sui, Deng, Gui, and Xia prefectures and other circuits was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: He wrote off back taxes in Xiang, Tang, Jun, Ru, Sui, Deng, Gui, Xia, and neighboring prefectures.

sentences.zh: 振亳州、房州、光化軍饑，遣使貸之。

translations.literal: Famine in Bozhou, Fang prefecture, and Guanghua Army was relieved; envoys were sent to lend grain.
translations.idiomatic: He sent grain loans to relieve famine in Bozhou, Fangzhou, and Guanghua Army.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，詔求直言。

translations.literal: In the third month, on gengshen, an edict sought blunt memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the third month he called for candid memorials from the empire.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以會州觀察使、知清遠軍田紹斌為靈州兵馬都部署。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Huizhou observation commissioner and director of Qingyuan Army Tian Shaobin was made overall deployment commander of Ling prefecture forces.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Tian Shaobin, observation commissioner of Huizhou and commander of Qingyuan Army, became supreme commander of the Lingzhou army.

sentences.zh: 己巳，廢邵武軍歸化縣金坑。

translations.literal: On jisi, the gold mines of Guihua county in Shaowu Army were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he closed the gold pits of Guihua county in Shaowu Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，吏部尚書、平章事呂蒙正罷為右僕射，以參知政事呂端為戶部侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on guiwei, Minister of Personnel and Grand Councilor Lü Mengzheng was dismissed to Right Vice Director; Participant in Governance Lü Duan was made Vice Director of the Ministry of Revenue and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the fourth month Personnel Minister and Chief Councilor Lü Mengzheng was demoted to right vice director, and Vice Councilor Lü Duan became revenue vice minister and chief councilor.

sentences.zh: 宣徽北院使、知樞密院事柴禹錫罷為鎮寧軍節度使，參知政事蘇易簡為禮部侍郎，以翰林學士張洎為給事中、參知政事。

translations.literal: Director of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat and Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Chai Yuxi was dismissed to military commissioner of Zhenning Army; Participant in Governance Su Yijian was made Vice Director of Rites; Hanlin academician Zhang Ji was made Supervising Censor and Participant in Governance.
translations.idiomatic: Chai Yuxi left the northern secretariat and military affairs bureau for the Zhenning command; Su Yijian became vice minister of rites; Hanlin scholar Zhang Ji joined the council as supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以宣徽北院使、同知樞密院事趙鎔知樞密院事。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Director of the Northern Court of the Palace Secretariat and Associate Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs Zhao Rong was made Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Zhao Rong, who had shared direction of military affairs, became its sole director.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，契丹犯雄州，知州何承矩擊敗之，斬其鐵林大將一人。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the Khitan raided Xiong prefecture; prefect He Chengjun defeated them and beheaded one of their Iron Forest generals.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Khitan raiders struck Xiongzhou; prefect He Chengju routed them and took an Iron Forest general's head.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遣使分決諸路刑獄，劫賊止誅首惡，降流罪以下一等。

translations.literal: On xinchou, envoys were dispatched to decide criminal cases in all circuits separately; for robbery only the chief culprits were executed, and exile and below were reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he sent commissioners circuit by circuit to review prisons: bandit leaders alone were executed, lesser sentences commuted one degree.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，慮囚。

translations.literal: On renyin, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he held a prison review.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，大雨，雷電。

translations.literal: On jiachen, heavy rain and thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen a thunderstorm broke.

sentences.zh: 開寶皇后宋氏崩。

translations.literal: Empress Song of the Kaibao era died.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Song, consort of Taizu, died.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，購求圖書。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on yiyou, books and maps were sought by purchase.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the sixth month he issued a call to buy books and maps.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣使諭李繼遷，授以鄜州節度使，繼遷不奉詔。

translations.literal: On bingxu, envoys were sent to instruct Li Jiqian and appoint him military commissioner of Bin prefecture; Jiqian did not accept the edict.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu he offered Li Jiqian the Binzhou command; Jiqian refused the appointment.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以銀州左都押衙張浦為銀青光祿大夫、檢校工部尚書、鄭州刺史、兼御史大夫，充本州團練使。

translations.literal: On jihai, Zhang Pu, Left Chief Escort Officer of Yin prefecture, was made Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Honor, Inspector-General of the Ministry of Works, Prefect of Zheng, and Concurrent Grand Censor, serving as regimental commissioner of his prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhang Pu, chief escort officer of Yinzhou, was ennobled and made prefect of Zheng and regimental commissioner of his home circuit.

sentences.zh: 己亥，許士庶工商服紫。

translations.literal: On jihai, commoners, artisans, and merchants were permitted to wear purple.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he allowed commoners, craftsmen, and merchants to wear purple robes.

sentences.zh: 是月，大熱，民有暍死者。

translations.literal: That month was fiercely hot, and among the people some died of heatstroke.
translations.idiomatic: That month a killing heat wave left people dead in the streets.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙寅，除陳、許等九州及光化軍今年夏稅。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on bingyin, this year's summer tax in Chen, Xu, and nine other prefectures and Guanghua Army was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the seventh month he canceled the summer levy for Chen, Xu, nine neighboring prefectures, and Guanghua Army.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，詔立壽王元侃為皇太子，改名恆，兼判開封府。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on renchen, an edict established Prince Yuan Kan of Shou as Crown Prince, changed his name to Heng, and made him concurrently judge of Kaifeng prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the eighth month he named Prince Yuan Kan of Shou as crown prince, renamed him Heng, and gave him concurrent authority over Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 大赦，文武常參官子為父後見任官者，賜勳一轉。

translations.literal: A great amnesty was proclaimed; for civil and military officials in regular audience whose sons succeeded them in office, one grade of merit was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a grand amnesty and awarded one step of merit to every attending official whose son held a post through hereditary privilege.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以尚書左丞李至、禮部侍郎李沆並兼太子賓客。

translations.literal: On guisi, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Li Zhi and Vice Director of Rites Li Hang were both made Concurrent Mentors of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Left Vice Director Li Zhi and Vice Minister of Rites Li Hang were both named mentors to the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，禁西北緣邊諸州民與內屬戎人昏娶。

translations.literal: On guimao, marriage between the people of the northwest border prefectures and affiliated tribesmen was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he banned frontier Han in the northwest from marrying women of affiliated tribal peoples.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，西南蕃牂牁諸蠻來貢，詔封西南蕃主龍漢王堯爲歸化王。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingwu, the southwestern Man of Zangge and other tribes came to court with tribute; an edict enfeoffed the southwestern chieftain Long Hanyao as King of Submission.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the ninth month southwestern Zangge tribes presented tribute, and the court enfeoffed their chief Long Hanyao as King of Submission.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，御朝元殿冊皇太子。

translations.literal: On dingmao, the Emperor mounted Chaoyuan Hall to invest the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Taizong held the crown-prince investiture at Chaoyuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚午，清遠軍言李繼遷入寇，率兵擊走之。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Qingyuan Army reported that Li Jiqian had raided; troops were led out and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Qingyuan Army reported a raid by Li Jiqian and beat him back.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌朔，皇太子讓宮僚稱臣，許之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on jiaxu the new moon, the Crown Prince declined his palace staff's use of the term "subject"; this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon in the tenth month the crown prince asked that his household not address him as a subject; the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，陝西轉運使鄭文寶坐撓邊，責授藍田縣令。

translations.literal: On yichou, Shaanxi transport commissioner Zheng Wenbao, for obstructing the border, was demoted and made magistrate of Lantian county.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zheng Wenbao, Shaanxi transport commissioner, was stripped of rank for hampering frontier operations and sent to govern Lantian county.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，閱武便殿。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiwei, military drill was reviewed at the Convenience Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the eleventh month he reviewed troops at the Convenience Hall.

sentences.zh: 是月，以峰州團練使上官正、右諫議大夫雷有終並為西川招安使，召王繼恩歸闕。

translations.literal: That month, Feng prefecture regimental commissioner Shangguan Zheng and Right Remonstrance Official Lei Youzhong were both made pacification commissioners of Xichuan, and Wang Jien was recalled to court.
translations.idiomatic: That month Shangguan Zheng of Fengzhou and remonstrator Lei Youzhong were named Sichuan pacification commissioners, and Wang Jien was recalled from the field.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，群臣奉表加上尊號曰法天崇道上聖至仁皇帝，凡五上，不許。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, the hundred officials submitted a memorial adding the honorific title Emperor Sagely in the Way, Revering Heaven, Supreme and Perfectly Humane, five times; it was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the twelfth month the court five times offered the title "Emperor Sagely in the Way, Revering Heaven, Supreme and Perfectly Humane"; he refused each time.

sentences.zh: 契丹犯邊，折御卿率兵禦之，卒于師。

translations.literal: The Khitan raided the border; Zhe Yuqing led troops to resist and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Khitan raiders struck the frontier; Zhe Yuqing met them in battle and died in camp.

sentences.zh: 斬馬步軍都軍頭孫贊于軍中。

translations.literal: Horse-and-foot army chief commander Sun Zan was beheaded in the army.
translations.idiomatic: Chief commander Sun Zan of the combined guards was executed before the ranks.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，新渾儀成。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the new armillary sphere was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the new armillary sphere was finished.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月辛亥，祀天地於圜丘，大赦，中外文武加恩。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month of the second year, on xinhai, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed at the Round Mound; a great amnesty was proclaimed, and civil and military officials within and without were advanced in grace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the first month of Zhidao 2 he sacrificed to Heaven and Earth at the Round Altar, proclaimed a general amnesty, and advanced officials throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，廢諸州司理判官。

translations.literal: On dingmao, judicial review officials in all prefectures were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he abolished the judicial-review posts in every prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月丙寅，以京師旱，遣中使禱雨。

translations.literal: In the third month, on bingyin, because the capital was dry, palace envoys were sent to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin in the third month drought in the capital sent palace envoys to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，命宰臣祀郊廟、社稷，禱雨。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the chief ministers were ordered to sacrifice at the suburban altars and the altars of soil and grain to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he ordered the chief ministers to offer rain prayers at the suburban and soil-and-grain altars.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，命侍衛馬軍都指揮使李繼隆為環、慶等州都部署，殿前都虞候范廷召副之，討李繼遷。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiaxu, Palace Cavalry commander Li Jilong was made overall deployment commander of Huan, Qing, and other prefectures, and Palace Front Chief Commandant Fan Tingzhao was made his deputy, to campaign against Li Jiqian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the fourth month cavalry commander Li Jilong became supreme commander of Huan, Qing, and neighboring prefectures, with palace commandant Fan Tingzhao as his deputy, to crush Li Jiqian.

sentences.zh: 癸未，雨。

translations.literal: On guiwei, rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei rain came.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，李繼遷寇靈州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guimao, Li Jiqian raided Ling prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the fifth month Li Jiqian raided Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月戊戌，黔州言蠻寇鹽井，巡檢使王惟節戰死。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuxu, Qian prefecture reported that Man raiders attacked the salt wells; patrol inspector Wang Weijie died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the sixth month Qianzhou reported tribal raiders on the salt wells; patrol inspector Wang Weijie fell fighting.

sentences.zh: 是月，亳州蝗。

translations.literal: That month, locusts in Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month locusts swarmed Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥朔，命殿前都指揮使王超為夏、綏、麟、府州都部署。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on jihai the new moon, Palace Front commander Wang Chao was made overall deployment commander of Xia, Sui, Lin, and Fu prefectures.
